sa: स वध्यमानः समरे भीमचापच्युतैः शरैः। स्मरन् भ्रातृवधं चैव पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥
en: Thus struck in that battle with arrows shot from Bhima's bow and recollecting the slaughter of his brother by that illustrious son of Pandu, the Rakshasa.

sa: सात्यकिरुवाच मुण्डानेतान् हनिष्यामि दानवानिव वासवः॥ प्रतिज्ञा पारयिष्यानि काम्बोजानेव मां वह।
en: Satyaki said I will slay these warriors with sharpened shafts like Vasava slaying the Danavas. Slaying the Kambojas, I will fulfill my vow. Carry me thither.

sa: क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि वैदेहि रामं प्रस्रवणे गिरौ। शतक्रतुमिवासीनं नागपृष्ठस्य मूर्धनि ॥
en: You shall soon behold, O Vaidehī, Rāma, on the mount Prasravana, like to the performer of hundred sacrifices seated on the back of the elephant (Airăvata).

sa: श्रुत्वा त्वत्तो भृगोर्भार्यां हरिष्याम्याश्रमादिमाम्। जातवेदः पश्यतस्ते वद सत्यां गिरं मम॥
en: Hearing from you whether she is Bhrigu's wife or not, I shall carry her away from the hermitage even in your presence. Therefore, answer me truthfully."

sa: शक्तेन बहुभृत्येन विपुले तिष्ठता बले। उभयत्र समर्थेन श्रुतवाक्येन चैव ह॥
en: You could prevent the slaughter, for you have a large following and a vast army. You had eloquence, and you had the power of making peace.

sa: केचिदाक्षिप्य करिणः शाश्वानपि रथान् करैः॥ विकर्षन्तो दिशः सर्वाः सम्पेतुः सर्वशब्दगाः।
en: Dragging down and overthrowing cars with their horses by their trunks, some elephants roved about in all directions, guided by the cries of those behind them.

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च। पञ्चमं सर्गमित्याहुभौतिकं भूतचिन्तकाः॥
en: Persons conversant with the principal elements hold that Sound and Touch and Form and Taste and Scent are the fifth creation, relating to the Great elements.

sa: निवातकवचा नाम दानवा युद्धदुर्मदाः। जानासि च यथा शक्रो नैताशक्नोति बाधितुम्॥
en: The Danavas named Nivatkavachas, who are hard to be vanquished in battle (also live here.) You know how Shakra is not able to cope with them.

sa: पन्थानममरैर्यान्तं शूरैश्चैवानिवर्तिभिः। अपि तत्संगतं मार्ग वयमध्यारुहेमहि॥ पितामहेन वृद्धेन तथाऽऽचार्येण धीमता। जयद्रथेन कर्णेन तथा दुःशासनेन च॥
en: We will now ascend the path that is trod by the celestials and by heroes who never retreat from battle, the path followed by our venerable grandfather, by the highly intelligent preceptor, by Jayadratha, by Karna and by Dushasana.

sa: तमहं रक्षती विप्रं शापादनपकारिणम्। पुत्रो मे त्वत्समो देव भवेदिति ततोऽब्रवम्॥
en: I wished to protect, from Surya's curse, the Brahmana who had done no evil. I, therefore, said, 'Let me have a son like you, O god.'

sa: न ह्यसावनृतं कर्तुमलं पार्थो धनंजयः। धर्मपुत्र कथं राजा भविष्यति मृतेऽर्जुने॥
en: Pritha's son Dhananjaya will never venture to falsify his vow. Oh, what will be the condition of king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, if Dhananjaya dies!

sa: मृत्युरुवाच प्रचोदितोऽहं कालेन पन्नग त्वामचूचुदम्। विनाशहेतुर्नास्य तमहं न प्राणिनः शिशोः॥
en: Mrityu said Guided by Kala, I, O serpent, sent you on this mission, and neither are you nor am I the cause of this child's death.

sa: मृत्पात्रस्य क्रियायां हि दण्डचक्रादयो यथा। कारणत्वे प्रकल्प्यन्ते तथा त्वमपि पन्नग॥
en: As in the making of an earthen pot the potter's wheel and rod and other things are all considered as causes, so are you, O serpent.

sa: स तद्विलं दण्डकाष्ठेन चखान न चाशकत्। तं क्लिश्यमानमिन्द्रोऽपश्यत्स वज्रं प्रेषयामास॥
en: He began to dig open the hole with a stick, but did not make much progress. Seeing his distress Indra sent his thunderbolt to his assistance.

sa: नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं मे श्रुतं वा घोरदर्शनम्। मृत्युरप्राप्तकालानां रामस्य विषये ह्ययम्॥
en: Save under the regime of Rama, I have never seen or heard of the dreadful death of such a boy who has not attained the age.

sa: सकुण्डलं तद् ददृशे पतमानं शिरो रथात्॥ पुण्यक्षयमनुप्राप्य पतन् स्वर्गादिव च्युतः।
en: That head adorned with ear-rings was seen to fall down from the car like a denizen of heaven falling down on the exhaustion of his virtues.

sa: सोऽयं वनमिदं प्राप्तो निर्जनं लक्ष्मणान्वितः। सीतया चाप्रतिद्वन्द्वः सत्यवादे स्थितः पितुः॥
en: And, having, in company with Laksmana and Sītā, come to the lone forest, I in humble guise am staying in the truthful speech of my father.

sa: इमे शूराश्च विक्रान्ता भृत्या मेऽस्त्रविशारदाः। योग्या रक्षोगणैर्योद्धं न रामं नेतुमर्हसि॥
en: And these servants of mine are Valiant, and warlike, and accomplished in weapons, and capable of fighting the Rākşasas,-therefore, it behove you not to take Rāma.

sa: तमब्रुवन् सुराः सर्वे समभिष्ट्रय संनताः॥ त्वां नियोक्ष्यामहे विष्णो लोकानां हितकाम्यया।
en: And bending low before him, the deities spoke to him saying, O Vişnu, for the benefit of the worlds, we shall appoint you to some work.

sa: अदित्यं जज्ञिरे देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशदरिंदम॥ आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ च परंतप ।
en: And of Aditi were born thirty-three deities, O repressor of your foes, viz., the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Asvinas, O subduer of enemies.

sa: येन राजन् हृता सीता तमन्वेषितुमर्हसि ॥ मद्वितीयो धनुष्पाणिः सहायैः परमर्षिभिः।
en: It is your duty, O king with bow in hand to search out the person who has carried away Sītā, along with me and the devotees.

sa: सरांसि च सुफुल्लानि नदीश्च विमलोदकाः। निरीक्षमाणा जग्मुस्ते दूताः कार्यवशाद् द्रुतम्॥
en: And beholding watery expan'ses filled with blown blossoms, and rivers containing pellucid waters, the envoys proceeded apace on account of the errand they had on hand.

sa: एका जनयिता तात पुत्रं वंशकरं तव। षष्ठिं पुत्रसहस्राणि अपरा जनयिष्यति॥
en: O child, one of your con sorts shall bring forth a son who will perpetuate your race; and the other give birth to sixty thousand sons.'

sa: तत्र वासिभिरानीता मुनिभिः सुव्रतैः सह॥ न्यवसत्स सुखं तत्र कामाश्रमपदे तथा।
en: And having been shown their destined place of rest along with ascetics of excellent vows, they happily passed that night in that hermitage affording every comfort.

sa: नैवं लक्ष्मण वक्तव्यो नायं परुषमर्हति। हरीणामीश्वरः श्रोतुं तव वक्त्राद् विशेषतः॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, you ought not to speak thus: and this lord of monkeys does not deserve to hear this harsh speech from your lips, in especial.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमृषि कृत्वा शिरसाभिप्रणम्य तम्। जगाम स्वपुरं राजा सभार्यो रघुनन्दन ॥
en: Then, O son of Raghu, having gone round the saint and bowed down the head, the king went to his own capital, accompanied by his consorts.

sa: भुञ्जाना मानुषान् भोगान् दिव्यांश्च वरवर्णिनि। न स्मरिष्यसि रामस्य मानुषस्य गतायुषः॥
en: O you of an exquisite countenance, enjoying these many things passing human, you shall not any more think of Rāma a human being of brief existence.

sa: पुरा दानवमुख्यानां विश्वकर्मा बभूव ह॥ येनेदं काञ्चनं दिव्यं निर्मितं भवनोत्तमम्।
en: He that as reared this excellent golden grove, and this charming mansion, was formerly the Viśvakarmā* of the principal Dänavas. *The name of the celestial architect.

sa: तौ तत्र हत्वा चतुरो महामृगान् वराहमृश्यं पृषतं महारुरुम्। आदाय मेध्यं त्वरितं बुभुक्षितौ वासाय काले ययतुर्वनस्पतिम्॥
en: And then the two (brothers) having slain the four kinds of beasts, viz., boars, rsyas, prsatas and maharurus,* and taking their flesh, in the evening took refuge under a mighty tree, feeling the demands of appetite. *Varieties of deer.

sa: तस्मिन् पुरवरे हृष्टा धर्मात्मानो बहुश्रुताः। नरास्तुष्टा धनैः स्वैः स्वैरलुब्धाः सत्यवादिनः॥
en: In that excellent city, the men were happy and righteous-souled, and widely-read, and each contented with his possessions, and devoid of covetousness, and speaking the truth.

sa: आरोह त्वं नरव्याघ्र स्थितां नावमिमां शनैः। सीतां चारोपयान्वक्षं परिगृह्य मनस्विनीम्॥
en: Do you ascend, gently, O foremost of men, the boat that stay here, after the making the virtuous Sītā ascend by taking her by the hand.

sa: तथैव गच्छतस्तस्य व्यपायाद् रजनी शिवा। उपास्य तु शिवां संध्यां विषयानत्यगाहत॥
en: And as he went on, the auspicious night was spent. And then having offered up his devotions to the beneficent Sandhyā, Rāma entered into another country.

sa: महानुभावस्य वचो निशम्य हरिपाणामधिपस्य तस्य। स्तदा च कार्यं हृदयेन विद्वान्॥
en: Hearing the words of that illustrious monarch of kings, that hero-greatest of monkeys-considered and felt in his heart as if his work had already been accomplished.

sa: यश्च मासानिवृत्तोऽग्रे दृष्ट्वा सीतेति वक्ष्यति। मत्तुल्यविभवो भोगैः सुखं स विहरिष्यति॥
en: He that, returning within a month, shall say,—I have seen Sītā,' shall pass his days in happiness, enjoying affluence like mine own and indulging all pleasures.

sa: दर्शयित्वा तु वैदेहीं कृत्स्नं तद्भवनोत्तमम्। उवाच वाक्यं पापात्मा सीतां लोभितुमिच्छया॥
en: And after having showed to Vaidehi the whole of that good lie of mansions, that wicked one, with the intention of tempting Sītā, spoke to her.

sa: तदसुखमनुकीर्तितं वचो भुवि पतितांश्च निरीक्ष्य वानरान्। भृशचकितमतिर्महामतिः कृपणमुदाहृतवान् स गृध्रराजः॥
en: Seeing the monkeys stretched on the earth, and hearing their piteous words describing their grief, that magnanimous king of vultures, with his mind agitated said (this).

sa: मेधावी तु ततो ध्यात्वा स किंञ्चिदिदमुत्तरम्। लब्धसंज्ञस्ततस्तं तु वेदज्ञो नृपमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then that one of capacious intelligence, versed in the Vedas, having pondered for a time, and regained his senses, returned to the king this excellent answer.

sa: वास्तुकर्मनिवेशं च भरतागमनं तथा। प्रसादनं च रामस्य पितुश्च सलिलक्रियाम् ॥
en: And Rāma's building a mansion there and sojourn; and Bharata's arrival, and his propitiation of Rāma; and Rāma's offering oblations to the manes of his father.

sa: सकृद् दृष्टास्वपि स्त्रीषु नृपेण नृपवत्सलः। मातृवद् वर्तते वीरो मानमुत्सृज्य धर्मवित्॥
en: Renouncing sense of self-importance that heroic conversant with righteousness, devoted to his king, regards as his mothers those on whom the monarch once cast his eyes.

sa: राज्यभ्रष्टस्य दीनस्य दण्डकान् परिधावतः। क्व सा दुःखसहाया मे वैदेही तनुमध्यमा॥
en: Where is that one of a slender waist, who is the help in trouble of me, deprived of my kingdom, dispirited, and running about the Dandakas?

sa: रक्षिता स्वस्य धर्मस्य स्वजनस्य च रक्षिता। वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो धनुर्वेदे च निष्ठितः॥
en: Practising all the duties of his class; and preserving those cleaving to him; versed in the profundities of the Vedas and the Vedāngas; accomplished in archery.

sa: लक्ष्मणेन सहायेन वनं गच्छस्व पुत्रक। नेयमर्हति कल्याणी वस्तुं तापसवद् वने॥
en: O son, taking Lakşmaņa for your help, go you to the forest. This auspicious one does not deserve to live in the woods like an ascetic.

sa: क्षिप्रं विसृज वैदेहीं मा त्वा घोरेण चक्षुषा। दहेद् दहनभूतेन वृत्रमिन्द्राशनिर्यथा॥
en: Do you soon leave off Vaidehī. Like to Indra burning down Vịtrāsura, Rāma, looking with his terrible eyes like flaming fire, shall reduce you to ashes.

sa: न लक्ष्मणास्मिन् मम राज्यविघ्ने माता यवीयस्यभिशङ्कितव्या। ज्जानासि दैवं हि तथाप्रभावम्॥
en: Know you now the mighty power of destiny and do you not blame therefore my younger mother and my father labouring under the influence of Destiny.

sa: तत्र पाण्डुरमेघाभं जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृतम्। कुबेरभवनं रम्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ विशाला नलिनी यत्र प्रभूतकमलोत्पला। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा अप्सरोगणसेविता ॥
en: There (you will behold) the charming mansion of Kuvera, resembling pale clouds, of burnished gold, built by Viśvakarmā; where (lies) the spacious tank overflowing with lotuses and lilies, thronged with swans and Kāraņdavas, and frequented by troops of Apsarās.

sa: इच्छेयं गिरिदुर्गाच्च भवद्भिरवतारितम्। यवीयसो गुणज्ञस्य श्लाघनीयस्य विक्रमैः॥ अतिदीर्घस्य कालस्य परितुष्योऽस्मि कीर्तनात्। तदिच्छेयमहं श्रोतुं विनाशं वानरर्षभाः॥ भ्रातुर्जटायुषस्तस्य जनस्थाननिवासिनः। तस्यैव च मम भ्रातुः सखा दशरथः कथम्॥ यस्य रामः प्रियः पुत्रो ज्येष्ठो गुरुजनप्रियः।
en: I wish to alight from this mountain-fastness. I have been well pleased by listening after a long time to the celebration of the virtues of my younger brother, cognizant of qualities and worthy of being extolled by reason of his prowess. You foremost of monkeys, I wish to hear of the destruction of Jaţāyu, who dwelt in Janasthāna. And how could Dasaratha, whose beloved eldest son is Rāma, dear to his superiors, be the friend of my brother?

sa: प्रतियाते तु भरते वसन् रामस्तदा वने। लक्षयामास सोद्वेगमथौत्सुक्यं तपस्विनाम् ॥
en: On Bharata having returned, while Rāma was dwelling in the woods, he noticed affright among the ascetics, added to a desire to remove to another place.

sa: किमर्थं नगरद्वारमिदं रुद्ध्वा विनर्दसे। दुन्दुभे विदितो मेऽसि रक्ष प्राणान् महाबल॥
en: O Dundhubhi, obstructing this my city-gate, why did you set up a terrible roar? Did you know my mighty strength? Do you save your own life.

sa: गते तु तस्मिन् भरतो वसिष्ठप्रमुखैर्द्विजैः॥ नियुज्यमानो राज्याय नैच्छद् राज्यं महाबलः। स जगाम वनं वीरो रामपादप्रसादकः॥
en: When king Dasaratha had passed away heaven, the mighty Bharata, although pressed by the Brāhmaṇas headed by Vasiştha, to rule the kingdom, did not wish for dominion. And that hero went the forest, with the view of propitiating Rāma.

sa: ततः क्षतजवेगेन आपुपूरे तदा बिलम्। तदहं विस्मितो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातुः शोकविषादितः॥
en: Then the cave became filled with blood gushing out vehemently. Seeing this, I became amazed, and exercised with the poison of grief of accountri my brother.

sa: शरेण निहतस्याद्य मया क्रुद्धेन रक्षसः। विराधस्य गतासोर्हि मही पास्यति शोणितम्॥
en: The earth shall drink the gore of this Rākşasa, Virādha, when deprived of life, after he has been slain with a shaft by my angry self.

sa: न्यवर्तत जनो राज्ञो रामं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम्। मनसाप्याशुवेगेन न न्यवर्तत मानुषम्॥
en: The retainers of the king stopped after circumambulating Rāma, but their minds did not turn back. But the others did not return either bodily or mentally.

sa: पश्य लक्ष्मण शीतेषु मानवं मनुसंहितम्। मोहयित्वा नयत्येनं न च प्राणैर्वियुज्यते॥
en: Behold, O Laksmana, this Manava weapon first used by Manu, depriving him of his senses has carried him off, and yet has not taken his life!

sa: कः शक्तस्तस्य देवस्य ख्यातस्य स्वेन कर्मणा। तादृशं प्रतिकुर्वीत अंशेनापि नृपात्मज॥
en: O king's son, who is capable of repaying even in part an action like that of the divine (Rāma) renowned by means of his own acts?

sa: प्रियेण किल दत्तं हि पितृलोकेषु राघव। अक्षयं भवतीत्याहुर्भावांश्चैव पितुः प्रियः॥
en: O Rāghava, anything offered to the (manes of the) ancestors by a beloved descendant, conduces to their eternal behoof; and you the favourite of our father.

sa: इदमेवामृतं प्राहू राज्ञि राजर्षयः परे। वनवासं भवार्थाय प्रेत्य मे प्रपितामहाः॥
en: O queen, this abode in the forest like to ambrosia has been declared by those royal saints, my ancestors, as working out one's emancipation after death.

sa: निःश्रेयसपरा मोहात् त्वया चाहं विगर्हिता। यैषाऽब्रुवं हितं वाक्यं वानरेन्द्र हितैषिणी॥
en: O lord of monkeys, out of your ignorance you didst neglect all my well meaning words which I said, being intent on your welfare and benefit.

sa: मम लालप्यमानस्य सुतार्थं नास्ति वै सुखम्। तदर्थं हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामीति मतिर्मम॥
en: Consistent with duty and interest,-Ever pining on account of a son, I know no happiness,-therefore it is my intention that I should celebrate a horse sacrifice.

sa: पृथिव्या सह वैहेह्या श्रिया च पुरुषर्षभः। क्षिप्रं तिसृभिरेताभिः सह रामोऽभिषेक्ष्यते॥
en: And that best of men, Räma, will soon be installed in the kingdom, in company with these three, the Earth, Vaidehī, and the goddess of victory.

sa: महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुणवेदिना। हरीणां प्रापितो राज्यं त्वं दुरात्मा पहात्मना॥
en: A sinful wretch and of wicked soul, you had obtained the kingdom of the monkeys through the agency of the eminently virtuous, kind and high-souled Rāma.

sa: तं परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। पर्यङ्के सीतया सार्धं रुदन्तः समवेशयन्॥
en: Then both Rāma and Lakşmaņa along with Sītā took the king up with their arms, and with tears in their eyes laid him upon the couch.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो विनतं नाम यूथपम्। अब्रवीद् रामसांनिध्ये लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः॥ शैलाभं मेघनिर्घोषमूर्जितं प्लवगेश्वरम्। सोमसूर्यनिभैः सार्धं वानरैर्वानरोत्तम॥ देशकालनयैर्युक्तो विज्ञः कार्यविनिश्चये। वृतः शतसहस्रेण वानराणां तरस्विनाम्॥ अधिगच्छ दिशं पूर्वां सशैलवनकाननाम्। तत्र सीतां च वैदेहीं निलयं रावणस्य च॥ मार्गध्वं गिरिदुर्गेषु वनेषु च नदीषु च।
en: Thus addressed, Sugrīva in presence of Rāma and the intelligent Lakşmaņa, said to a leader of herds of lord of apes, named Vinata, having the splendour of a hill, blazing and emitting sounds as those of clouds, O foremost of monkeys, accompanied with apes resembling the sun and the moon, you cognizant of time, place and morals, and sagacious in deciding course of action,-surrounded by hundreds and thousands are of active apes, march towards the Estern quarter, furnished with woods, forests and hills. There, in mountain fastnesses, and forests and rivers, do you search Videha's daughter, Sītā, as well as the abode of Rāvana.

sa: तत् कर्म रामस्य महारथस्य समेत्य देवश्च महर्षयश्च। स्तदा विमानाग्रगताः समेताः॥
en: And the celestials and Maharsis exceedingly rejoiced, assembled in the welkin in a body, and with joined hands extolled that feat of that mighty car-warrior Rāma.

sa: तदेतच्चिन्तयानेन स्मृतं पापं मया स्वयम्। तदा बाल्यात् कृतं देवि शब्दवेध्यनुकर्षिणा॥
en: O noble dame, the crime that I hitting by help of sound, had committed in my boyhood, has reverted to my recollection in course of thought.

sa: असंशयं प्रज्वलितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मर्मातिगैः शरैः। त्वं दहेः कुपितो लोकान् युगान्त इव भास्करः॥
en: Enraged, you, with your sharp and flaming shafts, capable of piercing into the vitals, canst burn up the worlds, like the sun at the universal dissolution.

sa: जीवितं सुखमर्थं च धर्महेतोः परित्यजन्। ह्रियमाणामधर्मेण मां राघव न पश्यसि॥
en: O Rāghava, for virtue have you renounced your life, happiness and wealth,-do you not see that I have been carried away by one of mighty iniquity?

sa: राजमूलो हि धर्मश्च यशश्च जयतां वर। तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु रक्षितव्या नराधिपाः॥
en: O you the best of conquerors, the king is the root of virtue and fame to the subjects; he should therefore be always protected by them.

sa: तमुवाच महातेजा रामो राजर्षिसत्तमः। किं मां भरत कुर्वाणं तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसे॥
en: To him spoke that foremost of Rājarşis, the highly energetic Rāma, O Bharata, my dear brother, what have I done that you have down by me?

sa: स दर्शनीयो बहुधा विच्छिन्नः काञ्चनो ध्वजः। जगाम धरणीं सूर्यो देवतानामिवाज्ञया॥
en: And on that exceedingly graceful golden standard being hewn down it seemed as if the sun dropped to the earth at the behest of the celestials.

sa: श्रुत्वा राज्ञोऽथ तद्वाक्यं मनसा स विचिन्त्य च। प्रदास्यते पुत्रवन्तं शान्ताभर्तारमात्मवान्॥
en: Hearing these words of the king, and having pondered well, he will make over to him Rsyasînga of subdued senses, together with Santa and his children.

sa: अतीता शर्वरी दुःखं या नो वर्षशतोपमा। अस्मिन् पञ्चत्वमापने पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवे॥
en: Then facing the royal priest, the eminent Vasistha, they said, "That night that had appeared like to an hundred years has at last been painfully passed.

sa: सागरस्य जलं लोके यावत्स्थास्यति पार्थिव। सगरस्यात्मजाः सर्वे दिवि स्थास्यन्ति देववत्॥
en: O lord of earth, as long as the waters of the ocean shall endure in the world. Sagara's sons shall reside in heaven like to celestials.

sa: दुःखे मे दुःखमकरोत्रणे क्षारमिवाददाः। राजानं प्रेतभावस्थं कृत्वा रामं च तापसम्॥
en: You, like one throwing alkali on a sore, have, by bringing about the death of the king and making Rāma an ascetic, heaped grief on grief.

sa: आगताः स्म यथोद्दिष्टं यं देशं मुनिरब्रवीत्। अयं पञ्चवटीदेशः सौम्य पुष्पितकाननः॥
en: (Now) we have come to the place to which we had been directed by the ascetic This, O amiable one, is Pañcavați furnished with blossoming woods.

sa: सा मूर्ध्नि बद्ध्वा रुदती राज्ञः पद्ममिवाञ्जलिम्। सम्भ्रमादब्रवीत् त्रस्ता त्वरमाणाक्षरं वचः॥
en: And weeping, she drew on her head the joined hands of the king resembling lotuses; and then flurried spoke these words hurriedly informed with extreme affection.

sa: मित्रं ह्यर्थगुणश्रेष्ठं सत्यधर्मपरायणम्। तद्वयं तु परित्यक्तं न तु धर्मे व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: He is the best friend who is gifted with wealth and is truthful; and your husband has relinquished such a friend gifted with these two qualities.

sa: उपावृत्ते मुनौ तस्मिन् रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। कृतपुण्याः स्म भद्रं ते मुनिर्यन्नोऽनुकम्पते॥
en: On the ascetic turning away, Rāma spoke to Lakṣmaṇa, “We had surely acquired religious merit, good betide you, since, the ascetic has shown compassion to us.

sa: अशोकतीर्थं तत्रैव कौन्तेय बहुलाश्रयम्। अगस्त्यतीर्थं पाण्ड्येषु वारुणं च युधिष्ठिर॥ कुमार्यः कथिताः पुण्याः पाण्ड्येष्वेव नरर्षभ। ताम्रपर्णी तु कौन्तेय कीर्तयिष्यामि तां शृणु॥
en: O son of Kunti, in this place, is the Tirtha called Ashoka abounding in many hermitages. O Yudhishthira, in the Pandya country are the Tirthas called Agastya and Varuna. O foremost of men, O son of Kunti, among the Pandyas, there is the Tirtha called Kumari, Hear, I shall now describe Tamraparia.

sa: निगृहीतं तु शूद्रेण यवक्रीतं स राक्षसः। ताडयामास शूलेन स भिन्नहृदयोऽपतत्॥
en: Having been thus stopped by the Shudra, (he stood motionless) and that Rakshasha hurled his spear at Yavakrit who then fell down pierced in the heart.

sa: क्रियतां यद् भवेच्छक्यं त्वया सुरगणेश्वर। वरांश्च मे प्रयच्छान्यान् यैरन्यान् भवितास्म्यति॥
en: O lord of the celestials, be pleased to do for me what is practicable. Favour me with boons by which I may excel all other men.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच मातले गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वमारोहस्व रथोत्तमम्। राजसूयाश्वमेधानां शतैरपि सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: Arjuna said : O Matali, go soon and make me ascend this best of cars that cannot be obtained even by a hundred Rajasuya and horse-sacrifices.

sa: ततो मोहं समापन्ने तनये मम भारत। मुमोच बाणांस्त्वरितः पुनरन्यान् दुरासदान्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, thereupon when my son became senseless, he (Shalva) without losing a moment again discharged at him other weapons, all difficult to withstand.

sa: मनसार्थान् विनिश्चित्य पश्चात् प्राप्नोति कर्मणा। बुद्धिपूर्वं स्वयं वीर पुरुषस्तत्र कारणम्॥
en: O hero, having settled upon some object in mind, a man carries it out into action aided by his intelligence; man is himself therefore the cause.

sa: कस्येशो नः पराजैषीरिति त्वामाह द्रौपदी। किं नु पूर्वं पराजैषीरात्मानमथवापि माम्॥
en: Pratikamin said Draupadi has asked you, "Whose lord were you at the time when you lost me in play? Did you lose yourself first or me?

sa: अन्धका यादवा भोजाः समेताः कंसमत्यजन्। नियोगात् तु हते तस्मिन् कृष्णेनामित्रघातिना॥
en: The Andhakas, the Yadavas the Bhojas, uniting together, abandoned Kansa. At the request (of the whole tribe) Kansa was kill by that slayer of foes, Krishna.

sa: जित्वा शत्रून् फलमाप्तं महद् वै मास्मान् क्षत्तः परुषाणीह वोचः। द्विषद्भिस्त्वं सम्प्रयोगाभिनन्दी मुहुर्द्वषं यासि नः सम्प्रयोगात्॥
en: O Khattwa, having vanquished our enemies we have gained great advantage. Do not use harsh words towards us. You are always willing to make friendship with the foes, and it is for this reason that you always hate us.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच यामेतामतुलां लक्ष्मी दृष्टवानसि पाण्डवे। तस्याः प्राप्तावुपायं मे शृणु सत्यपराक्रम॥
en: Shakuni said O hero whose prowess is truth, hear the means by which you can obtain the matchless prosperity that you have seen in the Pandava.

sa: तां सभामुपसम्प्राप्य तदा स निषधाधिपः। वैदा सहितो राजा निषसाद महीतले॥
en: Then on reaching that inn, the ruler of the Nishadhas seated himself on the surface of the earth with the daughter of the king of Vidharbha.

sa: स वै विवस्त्रो विकटो मलिनः पांसुगुण्ठितः। दमयन्त्या सह श्रान्तः सुष्वापधरणीतले॥
en: Destitute of his garments, unsightly, with his person unclean, covered with dust, he laid himself down with Damayanti on the surface of the earth in fatigue.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि स्रातकानां महात्मनाम्। दश मोक्षविदां तत्र यान् बिभर्ति युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: There were ten thousand most illustrious Snataka Brahmanas, who had perfect knowledge in the matter and means of salvation and whom Yudhishthira fed in the woods.

sa: महाराज महारण्ये अहमेकाकिनी सती। दमयन्त्यभिभाषे त्वां किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे।॥
en: O mighty monarch! in this vast wilderness I, your best-loved Damayanti, now forlorn and forsaken, am calling out your name; why do you not answer me?

sa: तदद्भुतममन्यन्त दृष्ट्वा सर्वे महीक्षितः। यद् विवेश महाबाहुं तत् तेजः पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: Seeing the effulgence (of Shishupala) enter (the body of) that mighty armed and excellent of men (Krishna), all the kings thought (the phenomenon) as very wonderful.

sa: आशीविषास्ते शिरसि पूर्णकोपा महाविषाः। मा कोपिष्ठाः सुमन्दात्मन् मा गमस्त्वं यमक्षयम्॥
en: O greatly wicked-minded man, deadly venomous and angry snakes are on your head. Do not provoke them any further and go to the land of Yama.

sa: हनूमानुवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत। भीमसेन न पर्याप्तो ममासौ राक्षसाधमः॥
en: Hanuman said: O mighty armed descendant of Bharata. O Bhimasena, it is as you say. That wretch of a Rakshasa (Ravana) was no match for me.

sa: निशाकाले स्मरंस्तस्याः श्लोकमेकं स्म गायति। स विभ्रमन् महीं सर्वां क्वचिदासाद्य किंचन॥ वसत्यनहर्हस्तद् दुःखं भूय एवानुसंस्मरन्।
en: Remembering her during the night, he sings the above verse. Then having wandered over the whole world and at last coming to a place where he, undeserving of the calamity that has overtaken him, resides always remembering his wife.

sa: ततोऽहं तस्य तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वज्रमुदीरयम्। देवराजस्य दयितं भीममस्त्रं नराधिप॥
en: Then, O lord of men, hearing these words of his, I let go that favourite weapon of the king of the celestials, the terrible Vajra (thunderbolt).

sa: आशीविषान् नेत्रविषान् कोपयेन च पण्डितः। एवं तेऽहं वदामीदं प्रयतः कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, this is the moral I carefully inculcate, that the learned men should never enrage such adders as have venom in their eyes.

sa: तां क्रन्दमानामत्यर्थं कुररीमिव वाशतीम्। करुणं बहु शोचन्तीं विलपन्तीं मुहुर्मुहुः सहसाभ्यागतां भैमीमभ्याशपरिवर्तिनीम्। जग्राहाजगरो ग्राहो महाकायः क्षुधान्वितः॥
en: As she was crying aloud and bitterly lamenting like a female osprey, grieving profusely in piteous words and bewailing again and again, a huge and hungry serpent suddenly scized the daughter of Bhima, who camc and rolled near it.

sa: एवमादि महाराज विलप्य दिवमास्थितः। कामगेन स सौभेन क्षिप्त्वा मां कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O great king, having thus bewailed and abused me, O descendant of Kuru, he rose up in the sky in (his car) Saubha, coursing at will.

sa: त्वया तु दुष्करः कस्मादिह वासः प्ररोचितः। वयं तु बहुसत्त्वेऽस्मिन् नवसामस्तपोधन॥
en: O ascetic, why have you selected to live here amidst these difficulties and dangers? We always live in these forests full of various sorts of animals.

sa: गृहीत्वा तु बलं सारं फाल्गुनः पाण्डुनन्दनः। दरदान् सह काम्बोजैरजयत् पाकशासनिः॥
en: The son of Pandu, and the son of Indra, Falguni (Arjuna), then took with him a select force and defeated the Daradas along with the Kambojas.

sa: ततो द्वारवतीं गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः। पिण्डारके नरः स्नात्वा लभेद् बहु सुवर्णकम्॥
en: Then one should go to Daravati with regulated diet and vows. The man who bathes in the Pindaraka obtains (the merit of giving away) much gold.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच षडाधाने दक्षिणामाहुरेके षट् चैवेमे ऋतवः कालचक्रम्। षडिन्द्रियाण्युत षट् कृत्तिकाश्च षट् साद्यस्काः सर्ववेदेषु दृष्टाः॥
en: Ashtavakra said: Six cows are paid as Dakshina on establishing the sacred fire; six are the seasons belonging to the wheel of time, six stars constitute the constellation Kirtika and the Vedas say six the number of Sadyaska sacrifice.

sa: सबैरिव यमो राजा मरुद्भिरिव वासवः। कुरुभिस्त्वं वृतो राजन् भासि नक्षत्रराडिव॥
en: Surrounded by the Kurus, O king, as Yama is surrounded by the Rudras and Vasava by the Marutas, you shine like the moon among the stars.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सम्प्रस्थितो राजा कौन्तेयो भूरिदक्षिणः। अगस्त्याश्रममासाद्य दुर्जयायामुवास हा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then the of Kunti, the king (Yudhishthira), distinguished for his large gifts, son came to the hermitage of Agastya and lived at Durjaya.

sa: अथात्रिरपि राजेन्द्र गौतमं प्रत्यभाषत। अयमेव विधाता हि यथैवेन्द्रः प्रजापतिः। त्वमेव मुह्यसे मोहान्न प्रज्ञानं तवास्ति ह॥
en: O king of kings, thereupon, Atri replied to Gautama “this king is as much the dispenser of our destiny as Indra, the lord of all creatures. Your intellect is clouded with ignorance and you have no sense at (all)."

sa: क्षन्तव्यं पुरुषेणेह सर्वापत्सु सुशोभने। क्षमावतो हि भूतानां जन्म चैव प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: O fair damsel, in every form of injury, persons should forgive; it is said that the birth of creatures is due to the forgiveness of mankind.

sa: तत्र गत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठ गमनादेव सिध्यति। कोटितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O best of kings, only going there one obtains success. Bathing in the Koti Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: अयं च सर्वराज्ञां वै बलश्लाघी महाबलः। जामदग्न्यस्य दयितः शिष्यो विप्रस्य भारत॥ येनात्मबलमाश्रित्य राजानो युधि निर्जिताः। तं च कर्णमतिक्रम्य कथं कृष्णस्त्वयार्चितः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, this greatly powerful hero whose prowess is the pride amongst all kings, who is the favourite disciple of the son of the Brahmana Jamadagni, the hero who defeated all the kings by his prowess alone, that Karna being present here, passing over him, why Krishna has been worshipped?

sa: केशवं केशिहन्तारमप्रमेयपराक्रमम्। पूज्यमानं मया यो वः कृष्णं न सहते नृपाः॥
en: "If there is any king(present here) who cannot bear the worship offered by me to Keshava, the slayer of Keshi, and the possessor of immeasurable energy.

sa: तदहं तेजसः कालं तव मन्ये नराधिप। धार्तराष्ट्रेषु लुब्धेषु सततं चापकारिषु॥
en: I therefore consider, O king, this to be the time when you should display your might to the avaricious sons of Dhritarashtra who always injure others.

sa: ततः सा बाष्पकलया वाचा दुःखेन कर्शिता। उवाच नैषधं भैमी शोकोपहतचेतना॥
en: Thereupon the daughter of Bhima, overpowered by grief and deprived of scnses by distresses, said to the prince of the Nishadhas in terins chocked with tears-

sa: दर्श च पौर्णमासं च यस्य तिष्ठेत् प्रतिष्ठितम्। इष्टिरष्टाकपालेन कार्या पथिकृतेऽग्नये।॥
en: He who has performed the Darsha and the Paurnamasya rites, must make the rectification by performing Ashtakapala rites in honour of the northern fire named Pathikrit.

sa: पापानुगास्तु पापास्ताः पतीनुपसृजन्त्युत। न जातु विप्रियं भर्तुः स्त्रिया कार्यं कथंचन॥
en: These wicked women, ever treading in the path of sin, do some times injure their husbands. But the wife should never do injury to her husband.

sa: जीदैर्चस्तमिदं सर्वमाकाशं पृथिवी तथा। अविज्ञानाच्च हिंसन्ति तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: The earth and the sky are all full of animal organisms. Which are unconsciously killed by men from ignorance, what have you to say to this?

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच शृणु राजन्नवहितः सह भ्रातृभिरच्युत। यस्त्वत्तो दुःखिततरो राजाऽऽसीत् पृथिवीपते॥
en: Brihadashva said : O prince, O you that never lapse hear attentively, with your brothers the history of the king who was more miserable than yourself.

sa: अथाचष्ट मार्कण्डेयोऽपूर्वमिदं श्रूयतां ब्राह्मणानां चरितम्॥
en: Markandeya replied, “Hear the account of the Brahmanas in the days of old."

sa: तस्य दृष्ट्वाभवद् बुद्धिः पार्थमिन्द्रासने स्थितम् कथं नु क्षत्रियः पार्थः शक्रासनमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Seeing Arjuna seated on the seat of Indra, he pondered as to how Partha had attained to the seat of Shakra, he being (but) a Kshatriya.

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच वित्तार्थिनमनुप्राप्तं विद्धि मां पृथिवीपते। यथाशक्त्यविहिंस्यान्यान् संविभागं प्रयच्छ मे॥
en: Agastya said : O lord of earth, know, I have come to you for wealth. Give me a portion of your wealth according to your ability.

sa: तावच्छूद्रसमो ह्येष यावद् वेदे न जायते। तस्मिन्नेवं मतिद्वैधे मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Before initiation into the Vedas every man is regarded as a Shudra. There being a difference of opinion on the point Svyambhuva Manu has laid down;

sa: न तेन दृष्टपूर्वोऽन्यः पितुरन्यत्र मानुषः। तस्मात् तस्य मनो नित्यं ब्रह्मचर्येऽभवन्नृप॥
en: O king, excepting his father, he did not ever see anybody else, therefore his mind was fully devoted to the duties of a continent life (Brahmacharya).

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच वित्तकामाविह प्राप्तौ विद्ध्यावां पृथिवीपते। यथाशक्त्यविहिस्यान्यान् संविभागं प्रयच्छ नौ॥
en: Agastya said : O ruler of earth, know, I have come to you for wealth. Give me a portion of your wealth according to your ability,

sa: ते यूयं मानसैः शुद्धाः शरीरनियमव्रतैः। दैवं व्रतं समास्थाय यथोक्तं फलमाप्स्यथ॥
en: Observing human vows in respect of your body and purifying your mind by observing the celestials vows, acquire the fruits of Tirthas as recited (to you).

sa: मानुषेण कृतं कर्म विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्। स तच्छ्रुत्वा तु संक्रुद्धः सर्वयक्षगणाधिपः॥
en: All this has been done by one man. Do what you think proper now." Hearing all this, the king of all the Yakshas in great anger,

sa: स समीक्ष्य महीपाल: स्वां सुतां प्राप्तयौवनाम्। अपश्यदात्मना कार्यं दमयन्त्याः स्वयंवरम्॥
en: The king, secing his daughter had attained to puberty, observed in his mind that it was his Own duty to make arrangements for Damayanti's Svayamvara (marriage).

sa: भीम उवाच मनःप्रीतिकरं भद्रे यद् ब्रवीषि सुमध्यमे। तन्मे प्रीणाति हृदयममृतप्राशनोपमम्॥
en: Bhima said: O blessed lady, O beauty of slender waist the pleasing words you say are as delightful to my mind, as the drinking of ambrosia.

sa: विदुर उवाच क्षान्तमेव मया राजन् गुरुर्मे परमो भवान्। एषोऽहमागतः शीघ्रं त्वदर्शनपरायणः॥ भवन्ति हि नरव्याघ्र पुरुषाधर्मचेतसः। दीनाभिपातिनो राजन् नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥
en: Vidura said: O king, I have forgiven you. You are my Guru (superior), worthy of my highest respect, I have speedily come here, being eagerly desirous of seeing you. O best of men, all virtuous men are partial to those that are distressed. O king, this is scarcely the result of deliberations.

sa: ततोऽपश्यं महाराज प्रपतन्तमहं तदा। सौभाच्छूरसुतं वीर ततो मां मोह आविशत्॥
en: O great king, O hero, I now saw the son of Sura (my father) himself falling from the Saubha (car). At this sight I fainted away.

sa: अत्र राजा महेष्वासो मान्धातायजत स्वयम्। साहदेविश्व कौन्तेय सोमको ददतां वरः॥
en: son of Kunti, here did the great bow-man, king Mandhata, himself perform sacrifices, so did also Somaka, the son of Sahadeva, that foremost of all boon-givers.

sa: कामकृद् यो द्विजातीनां श्रुतस्तात यथा पुरा। अत्यन्तमाश्रमः पुण्यः शरभङ्गस्य विश्रुतः॥
en: O child, we have heard that Sharabhanga who in the days of yore used to gratify much the Brahmanas, had his sacred and celebrated hermitage here.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच यद्यत्र वृद्धेषु कृतः प्रवेशो युक्तं प्रवेष्टुं मम द्वारपाल। वयं हि वृद्धाश्चरितव्रताश्च वेदप्रभावेण समन्विताश्च॥
en: Ashtavakra said: O gate-keeper, if this be the order that only old men can enter here, then we can enter. We also are old and we have observed severe vows. We are endued with the effulgence of the Vedas,

sa: अत्र कालञ्जरं नाम पर्वतं लोकविश्रुतम्। तत्र देवह्रदे स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: There in that Tirtha is the celebrated mountain called Kalanjara. Bathing in the celestials lake there, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: लोपामुद्रोवाच सहस्रसम्मितः पुत्र एकोऽप्यस्तु तपोधन। एकोहि बहुभिः श्रेयान् विद्वान् साधुरसाधुभिः॥
en: Lopamudra said : O great ascetic, let me have one son equal to one thousand. One learned and good son is preferable to many bad ones.

sa: ततो द्वाराणि पिदधुर्दानवास्त्रस्तचेतसः। संविधाय पुरे रक्षां न स्म कश्चन दृश्यते॥
en: Then having made arrangements for the defence of their city, the Danavas. with hearts troubled with fear, closed the gates so that nothing could be seen.

sa: तत्राश्रौषमहं चैतत् कर्म भीमस्य भारत। ब्राह्मणानां कथयतां ये तत्रासन् समागताः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, I heard there (in the forest) of this great deed of Bhima from the Brahmanas who had assembled there (round the Pandavas).

sa: द्रौपदीवाक्यपाथेयो भीमः शीघ्रतरं ययौ। कम्पयन् मेदिनी पद्भ्यां निर्घात इव पर्वसु॥
en: Having the words of Draupadi as his provisions for the journey, Bhima went with greater speed, shaking the earth with his tread as does a hurricane.

sa: राज्ञा पृष्टः स कुशलं सुखासीनश्च संजयः। शशंसागमने हेतुमिदं चैवाब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: He was asked by the king about the welfare of all. When he was comfortably seated, he told the reason of his coming in these words.

sa: तस्य नादेन संत्रस्ताः पक्षिण: सर्वतोदिशम्। विमुक्तनादाः सम्पेतुः स्थलजा जलजैः सह॥
en: Being terrified by his yells, birds along with other creatures that live on land or in water utterring cries of fear dropped down in all directions.

sa: स तेनाभिहतो दीर्णो गिरिः श्वेतोऽचलैः सह। उत्पपात महीं त्यक्त्वा भीतस्तस्मान्महात्मनः॥
en: The white mountain being thus pierced by him was greatly afraid of him and disassociating himself from the earth she fled away with the other mountains.

sa: ततस्ते सुश्रुवुः नारदस्य वचो महत्। श्रुत्वैव चाब्रुवन् हृष्टा गच्छामो वयमप्युत।॥
en: They then all heard the speeches of Narada pregnant with lofty ideas and becoming greatly delighted to hear them said that they would also go there.

sa: तानि सर्वाणि दुःखानि प्राप्नोति वितथं ब्रुवन्। समक्षदर्शनात् साक्षी श्रवणाच्चेति धारणात्॥
en: He who speaks false gets all these sorts of grief. A man becomes a witness in consequence of his having seen, heard and understood a thing.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अनुज्ञातस्तु कृष्णेन पाण्वो भ्रातृभिः सह। ईजितुं राजसूयेन साधनान्युपचक्रमे॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been commanded by Krishna, the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira) with his brothers employed himself to collect the necessary materials for the Rajasuya (sacrifice).

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच सरथौ सधनुष्कौ च भीमसेनधनेजयौ। यमौ च वरये राजन्नदासान् स्ववशानहम्॥
en: Draupadi said O king, grant this boon that Bhimasena, Arjuna and the twins with their bows and cars be freed from slavery and gain their liberty.

sa: आस्थाय रुचिरं याति पुष्पकं नरवाहनः। ऐरावतं समास्थाय शक्रश्चापि सुरैः सह॥
en: Riding on the backs of human beings and riding (also) on his beautiful car Pushpaka. Indra also with the celestials went riding on his elephant Airavata,

sa: पन्ये मन्यु समुद्भूताः पुत्राणां तव संयुगे। अन्तं पार्थाः करिष्यन्ति भार्यामर्षसमन्विताः॥
en: I am sure, the sons of Pritha, angry as they are at the insult offered to their wedded wife, will kill all your sons in battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रविश्य तां सभां पार्था युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। समेत्य पार्थिवान् सर्वान् पूजार्हानभिपूज्य च॥ यथावयः समेयाना उपविष्टा यथार्हतः। आसनेषु विचित्रेषु स्पर्ध्यास्तरणवत्सु च॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having entered the Sabha, the sons of Pritha with Yudhishthira at their head met all the kings that were present there. Worshipping all those that deserved to be worshipped and saluting others as each deserved according to his age, they took their seats on pure seats covered with costly carpets.

sa: अपर्यन्तं धनौघं तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रोरहं नृपा शमं नैवाभिगच्छामि चिन्तयानो विशाम्पते।॥
en: O king, seeing that enormous collection of wealth belonging to the enemy. I cannot enjoy peace of mind. 'I am afflicted with their thoughts. O king.

sa: शूद्राभीरगणाश्चैव ये चाश्रित्य सरस्वतीम्। वर्तयन्ति च ये मत्स्यैर्ये च पर्वतवासिनः॥
en: The Shudras, the Abhiras living on the banks of the Sarasvati, and all those tribes that lived on fishing and those that lived on the mountains.

sa: एतत् कृतयुगं नाम त्रैगुण्यपरिवर्जितम्। त्रेतामपि निबोध त्वं यस्मिन् खत्रं प्रवर्तते।॥
en: Such was Krita Yuga devoid of the these qualities. Now hear from me all about the Treta Yuga in which sacrifices were introduced (in the word).

sa: द्रौपद्या वनवासिन्याः प्रियं कर्तुं समुद्यतः। सोऽचिन्तयद् गते स्वर्गमर्जुने मयि चागते॥
en: Eager to do the favourite work of Draupadi exiled in the forest, he thought, "Now that Arjuna had gone to heaven and I have come away

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदा नलो राजा विशाम्पते। आजगाम पुनस्तत्र यत्र देवाः समागताः॥
en: O ruler of the earth! thus addressed by the daughter of the king of the Vidarbhas, king Nala returned where the assembled celestials took their quarters.

sa: ते पथानन्तरान् वृक्षान् वल्मीकान् विषमाणि च। पाणिभिः परिमार्गन्तो भीता वायोर्निलिल्यिरे॥
en: Being pushed by the wind and being alarmed, they felt their way by their hands and they took shelter under the way-side trees, anthills and caverns.

sa: शापक्षये तु निर्वृत्ते भवितासि पुनर्द्विजः। एवं शप्तः पुरा तेन ऋषिणास्य्युचतेजसा॥
en: On the expiration of this curse, you shall again become a Brahmana. I was thus in the days of yore cursed by that greatly effulgent Rishi.

sa: न हि तेऽध्यगमञ्जानु तदानीं नाद्य भारत। धर्मात् प्रियतरं किंचिदपि चेज्जीवितादिह॥
en: Neither then, nor even now, O descendant of Bharata, has anything appeared to you dearer than virtue, which is dearer to you even than your life.

sa: ऋषिरुवाच नान्यथा भविता शाप एवमेतदसंशयम्। आनृशंस्यात् त्वहं किञ्चित् कर्तानुग्रहमद्य ते॥
en: The Rishi said : The curse that I have pronounced can never be falsified. This is certain. But for kindness I shall do you a favour.

sa: कौरवैः परिभूतां मां किं न जानासि केशव हे नाथ हे रमानाथ व्रजनाथार्तिनाशन। कौरवार्णवमग्नां मामुद्धरस्व जनार्दन॥
en: O Keshava, do you not see that I am persecuted by the Kurus. O lord, O husband of Lakshmi O lord of Vraja, O destroyer of all affliction, O Janardana, save me who am sinking in the Kuru ocean!

sa: जानामि त्वां परिश्रान्तं ततो विश्रामकाक्षिणम्। मार्कण्डेय इहास्स्व त्वं यावदिच्छसि भार्गव॥
en: "O child, I know you are fatigued and you are eager for rest. O descendant of Bhrigu, O Markandeya, rest here as long as you like.

sa: वर्ण्यमानेषु च मया भवत्सु रुचिरानना। मामेव गतसंकल्पा वृणीते सा सुरोत्तमाः॥
en: O the most excellent of the celestials, although I related all about you, yet the faircomplexioned one settled her mind to choose me for her lord.

sa: कीर्तिस्तु ते भारत पुण्यगन्धा नश्येद्धि लोकेषु चराचरेषु। तत् प्राप्य राज्यं कुरुपुङ्गवानां शक्यं महत् प्राप्तुमथ क्रियाश्च॥
en: But then, O Bharata, the sacred fragrance of your fame will disappear from (both) the mobile and the immobile worlds; (for) regaining the kingdom of the most exalted of the Kurus, you will be able to perform glorious deeds.

sa: ततः स पशुमुत्सृज्य देवयानेन जग्मिवान्। तत्रानुवंशो रुद्रस्य तं निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Thereupon giving up the beast, he went away by the path trodden by the celestials. O Yudhishthira, hear from me me what then happened to Rudra.

sa: त्वया विनिकृता माता पिता च द्विजसत्तम। अनिसृष्टोऽसि निष्क्रान्तो गृहात् ताभ्यामनिन्दित॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, O faultless one, you have wronged your father and mother, for you have left home for learning the Vedas without their permission.

sa: देवा ऊचुः करिष्य इति संश्रुत्य पूर्वमस्मासु नैषध। न करिष्यसि कस्मात् त्वं व्रज नैषध मा चिरम्॥
en: The Gods said : O king of the Nishadhas, you promised to us beforehand that you would do it. O king of the Nishadhas, why, therefore will you not act up to it? Tell us without (a moment's) hesitation.

sa: एवं दृष्टं मया राजंस्तस्मिन् प्राप्ते युगक्षये। आश्चर्यं भरतश्रेष्ठ सर्वधर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O king, O best of the Bharata race, O foremost of all virtuous men, I saw all this wonderful sight at the end of the Yuga.

sa: तानुवाच महातेजाः कौरवान् मधुसूदनः। सर्वे भवन्तो गच्छन्तु सर्वा मेऽपचितिः कृता॥
en: The slayer of Madhu, of great energy said to those descendants of Kuru, 'All of you may go away; by these offers have you honoured me.'

sa: एवमादीनि वाक्यानि श्रुत्वा तस्याथ जानकी। पिधाय की सुश्रोणी मैवमित्यब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: Addressed in this strain, the daughter of Janaka, endued with beautiful lips, shut up her ears (with hands) and said "Do not say such words again.

sa: श्रुत्वा तद् रावणो वाक्यं सीतयोक्तं सुनिष्ठुरम्॥ प्रत्याख्यातोऽपि दुर्मेधाः पुनरेवाब्रवीद् वचः। काममङ्गानि मे सीते दुनोतु मकरध्वजः॥ न त्वामकामां सुश्रोणी समेष्ये चारुहासिनीम्।
en: Hearing those cruel words spoken by Sita, Ravana, of malicious intelligence, although thus rejected (by Sita) spoke to her these words again. "O Sita, let that god having the Makara for his emblem consume me. But O fair-hipped lady of sweet smiles, I will, by no means enjoy you against your will.

sa: त्वं चापि तत् तथा कृष्ण सर्वंसम्पादयिष्यसि। नाहं तदभ्यसूयामि यथा वागभ्यभाषत॥
en: You too, O Krishna, will do all that has been said by that voice, I do not doubt the truth of what the voice has said.

sa: सम्यग्दृष्टिर्महाप्राज्ञो बालं त्वां ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्। अयं प्राप्य महत् कृच्छ्रे पुनर्वृद्धिं गमिष्यति॥
en: A very wise man, possessing great foresight, said to you while you were a child: "After meeting with great difficulties, he will again meet with prosperity.”

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु भेरीणां नास्ति निःस्वनः। अनाहताः पाण्डवानां नदन्ति पटहाः किल॥
en: In the army of the son of Dhritarashtra, no sound comes from the drums while those of the Pandavas give forth sounds when even not struck.

sa: आददानस्य हि शरान् संधाय च विमुञ्चतः। विकर्षतश्च गाण्डीवं नान्तरं समदृश्यत॥
en: Nobody could measure the difference of time between the acts of picking up arrows from holster, putting on bow, shooting and giving tension to the bow.

sa: उपश्रुतिरुवाच उपश्रुतिरहं देवि तवान्तिकमुपागता। दर्शनं चैव सम्प्राप्ता तव सत्येन भाविनि॥
en: Upashruti said I am, O goddess, Upashruti, who have come to you. O you of noble mind, I have appeared in your sight through your truthfulness.

sa: कृते विवाहे तु तदा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ वित्तं यदुपाहरदच्युतः॥
en: On completion of the conjugal ceremony, Yudhishthira, an incarnate to Dharma, made a gift of the major part of money received from lord Krishna to Brahmanas.

sa: पुत्रोऽहमपि विप्रर्षेः साक्षाद् विश्रवसो मुनेः। पञ्चमो लोकपालानामिति मे प्रथितं यशः॥
en: (Again) I am the son to that Brahmanic sage, the Muni Vishrava and am celebrated under the name of the fifth Lokapala (regent of the universe).

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वः पुरुषो रविर्यथा वितर्कयन् नास्य लभामि निश्चयम्। तथास्य चित्तं ह्यपि संवितर्कयन् नरर्षभस्यास्य न यामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: This man, not seen before, is like one seen; thinking and thinking over I cannot come to a definite conclusion (who he may be); nor do I, with a serious deliberation, understand the intention of that best of men.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच अर्जुन केशव ब्रूयास्त्वयि जाते स्म सूतके। उपोपविष्टा नारीभिराश्रमे परिवारिता॥शा
en: Kunti said OKeshava, speak this to Arjuna “At the time of your birth when I was seated: in the lying-in-room in the asylum surrounded by females,

sa: मन्त्रिद्विजान् सूतमुखान् विशस्तथा ये चापि केचित् परितः समासते। पप्रच्छ कोऽयं प्रथम समेयिवान् नृपोपमोऽयं समवेक्षते सभाम्॥
en: The king Virata asked his counsellors, the Brahmanas, the charioteers, the Vaishyas and all others who took their seats about him, "who might be the man that has come first, and just like a king appears in my court.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुन्त्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा भीष्मद्रोणौ महारथौ। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमूचतुः शासनातिगम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of Kunti the great carwarriors Bhishma and Drona, said these words of Duryodhana who had grown unaccustomed to obey their orders.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पुरोहितं ते प्रस्थाप्य नगरं नागसाह्वयम्। दूतान् प्रस्थापयामासुः पार्थिवेभ्यस्ततस्ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said His (Drupada's) priest, having gone towards the city called after the elephant, the Pandavas sent in messengers to the rulers in the several parts.

sa: श्वेताः काञ्चनसंनाहा रथे युज्यन्ति मे हयाः। संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य तेनाहं श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: When I fight in the battle field the steeds that are yoked to my car are white and golden hued and hence they call me Shvetavahana.

sa: तदिदं व्यसनं घोरं त्वया द्यूतमुखं कृतम्। असमीक्ष्य सदाचारान् सार्धं पापानुबन्धनैः॥
en: By you and your wicked followers was planned this terrible calamity by means of dice without consulting with those who are of good habits of life.

sa: सुहृदामर्थकामानां यो न तिष्ठति शासने। प्राज्ञानां कृतविद्यानां स नरः शत्रुनन्दनः॥
en: That man, who does not follow the instructions of well-wishers who desire his good and who are wise and learned, is the delight of his enemies.

sa: अथैनमब्रवीद् गृध्रो मुञ्च मुञ्चेति मैथिलीम्। ध्रियमाणे मयि कथं हरिष्यसि निशाचर॥
en: The vulture then said to him "let go the princess of Mithila; leave her. O night-ranger, how can you carry her off when I am alive?

sa: तानभिप्रेक्ष्य संग्रामे विशीर्णानिव पर्वतान्। भीतो भीमस्य संस्पर्शात् स्मर्ताऽसि वचनस्य मे॥
en: Beholding them in the field of battle like mountains separated and struck with fear by coming in contract with Bhima, then will you remember my words.

sa: अग्रतः सूतपुत्रस्तु कर्णस्तिष्ठतु दंशितः। अहं सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य पश्चात् स्थास्यामि पालयन्।।२३
en: Let Karna, the son of charioteer, clad in a coat of mail, stand in the front. And I shall command the entire army in the rear.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इत्युक्तः पितृराजस्तां भगवान् स्वचिकीर्षितम्। यथावत् सर्वमाख्यातुं तत्प्रियार्थं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Markandeya said : Thus addressed by her, the divine lord of the Pitris, in order to please her, began faithfully to relate everything about his intentions.

sa: यदा नान्यं प्रवृणुते वरं वै द्विजसत्तमः। तदैनमब्रवीद् भूयो राधेयः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: When that most exalted of the twice-born ones did not ask for any other boon, the son of Radha then addressed him again with a smile,

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दाक्ष्यमेकपदं धर्म्य दानमेकपदं यशः। सत्यमेकपदं स्वयं शीलमेकपदं सुखम्॥
en: Yudhishthira replied The crowning refuge of religion is liberality, that of renown is charity, that of heaven is truth and that of happiness is good conduct.

sa: अराजकं जगत् सर्वमभिभूतमुपद्रवैः। ततो भीताऽभवन् देवाः को नो राजा भरेदिति॥
en: And the entire world oppressed with anarchy became overpowered with all sorts of disasters and the gods became frightened for no hody would be their king.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कर्णेन राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। उवाच चाङ्गराजानं वाष्पगद्गदया गिरा॥
en: Vaiskampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Karna, king Duryodhana thus spoke in reply to the Anga king (Karna) in a voice choked with tears.

sa: इत्येवं वदतस्तस्य तदा दुर्वाससो मुनेः। देवदूतो विमानेन मुद्गलं प्रत्युपस्थितः॥ हंससारसयुक्तेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना। कामगेन विचित्रेण दिव्यगन्धवता तथा॥
en: When the Rishi Durvasa was thus speaking, celestial messenger appeared before Mudgala in a car yoked with swans and cranes, adorned with numerous bells, scented with divine fragrance, picturesquely painted and possessing the power of going everywhere at will.

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थं त्वयैवासौ सपुत्रेण विवासितः। स तत्र विवसन् सर्वान् वशमानीय पार्थिवान्॥
en: He was exiled to Indraprastha by yourself with your sons and while staying there be ! brought under his sway all the rulers of the earth.

sa: मेधाविनं ह्यर्थकामं कुरूणां बहुश्रुतं वाग्मिनं शीलवन्तम्। स तं राजा धृतराष्ट्रः कुरुभ्यो न सस्मार विदुरं पुत्रकाम्यात्॥
en: The king Dhritarashtra, from a desire to please his son, remembered not that Vidura was a wise man among the Kurus and wished for the well-being of the Kurus, of very great learning, adept at speech and well behaved.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं हि कौन्तेयं परं धर्ममिहास्थितम्। परां गतिमसम्प्रेत्य न त्वं जेतुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, is established on sound and strict virtue in this world. You are not fit to vanquish him without losing your life.

sa: प्रतीपमिव मे भाति युयुधानेन भारती। व्यस्ता सीमन्तिनी ग्रस्ता प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना॥
en: The army of the Bharatas appears to me as already fallen down like a woman troubled and afflicted and struck by one of the long arms.

sa: पतनान्ते महद् दुःखं परितापः सुदारुणः। स्वर्गभाजश्चरन्तीह तस्मात् स्वर्गं न कामये॥
en: O Brahmana, persons who are addicted to sensual objects or those who are subject to arrogance, coveteousness, ignorance, anger and envy, cannot go to that place.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि कौन्तेय न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि। राज्यात् स्फीतात् परिभ्रष्टस्तपसा तदवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Therefore, O son of Kunti, you ought not to grieve. You have been deprived of a great kingdom, but you will region it by your asceticism.

sa: कथमुत्सृज्य वैदेहीं वने राक्षससेविते। इति तं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा प्राप्तोऽसीति व्यगर्हयत्।१४॥
en: Beholding his brother, (Rama) said to him with a rebuke "How could you leave alone the princess of Videha in the forest frequented by the Rakshasas"?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युयुधानस्ततो वीरः सात्वतानां महारथः। महता चतुरङ्गेण बलेनागाद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did the hero Yuyudhana of the Satvata race, of great prowess, come to Yudhishthira with a large army containing all the four elements.

sa: स तं सत्कृत्य कौरव्यः प्रेषयामास पाण्डवान्। सभामध्ये समाहूय संजयं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: And the son of Kuru, having done him honours, sent him to the sons of Pandu and having summoned Sanjaya to the council, said these words.

sa: पितेवास्मान् समाधत्ते यः सदा पार्थिवर्षभः। श्वशुरो द्रुपदोऽस्माकं सेनाग्रं स प्रकर्षतु॥
en: That best among the rulers of the earth who ever supports us as a father, our father-inlaw Drupada, should stand at the head of our army.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मिन् बहुमृगेऽरण्ये अटमाना महारथाः। काम्यके भरतश्रेष्ठा विजहस्ते यथामराः॥
en: Viashampayana said : Those mighty car-warriors, the foremost of the Bharata race, wandering like immortals in the forest of Kamyaka abounding in many deer, were pleased.

sa: अहं च संशयं प्राप्तः कृच्छ्रामापदमास्थितः। मातापितृभ्यां हि विना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: And (on account of which) I also placed in this critical position am filled with anxiety. Without my parents I do not care to bear life.

sa: दुर्योधनेन निकृता वर्षमद्य चतुर्दशम्। दुःखादपि सुखं नः स्याद् यदि पुण्यफलक्षयः॥
en: It is fourteen years now since they were exiled by Duryodhana; and happiness should be ours, if misery puts an end to the fruits of vice.

sa: द्रोणात् कृपाच्च रामाच्च सोऽस्त्रग्रामं चतुर्विधम् लब्ध्वा लोकेऽभवत् ख्यातः परमेष्वासतां गतः॥
en: Having obtained from Drona, Kripa and Rama (i.e. Parashurama), all the four kinds of weapons, he (Karna) became celebrated in the world as a great bowman.

sa: दह्यमानेन तु हृदा रामोऽभ्यपतदाश्रमम्। स ददर्श तदा गृधं निहतं पर्वतोपमम्॥
en: Rama then with a burning heart quickly proceeded forwards the hermitage and (on the way) he beheld the vulture, huge as mountain, in his last moments.

sa: तेषां चैव गतिस्तीर्थैर्वासश्चैषां प्रचिन्त्यताम्। नीतिर्विधीयतां चापि साम्प्रतं या हिता भवेत्॥
en: It is proper for you to find out the way they have followed and their whereabouts through spies and adopt what may conduce to your well-being.

sa: हत्वा कुरून् महाजन्ये राज्यं प्राप्य धनंजयः। भ्रातृभिः सह कौन्तेयस्त्रीन् मेधानाहरिष्यति॥
en: Slaughtering the Kurus in a great battle and obtaining the kingdom, Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, along with his brothers, will perform three grand sacrificial rites.'

sa: अशिष्यं शास्ति यो राजन् यश्च शून्यमुपासते। कदर्यं भजते यश्च तमाहुर्मूढचेतसम्॥
en: He is said to be foolish-minded who punishes, Oking him who deserves not punishment, who flatters big people without their knowledge and who attends on misers.

sa: ब्राह्मणः प्रचरेद् भैक्षं क्षत्रिय: परिपालयेत्। वैश्यो धनार्जनं कुर्याच्छूद्रः परिचरेच्च तान्॥
en: A Brahmana should live on alms, a Kshatriya should protect his subjects, a Vaishya should acquire wealth and a Shudra should serve all these other orders.

sa: प्राप्य वामनरूपेण प्रच्छन्नं ब्रह्मरूपिणा। बलेर्यथा हृतं राज्यं विक्रमैस्तच्च ते श्रुतम्॥
en: Then how disguising himself in the form of dwarf, he (Vishnu) by his prowess deprived vail of the kingdom of Bali, have been heard by you?

sa: इत्युक्त्वा समयं कृत्वा विश्वास्य च परस्परम्। अभ्येत्य सर्वे किष्किन्धा तस्थुर्युद्धाभिकाक्षिणः।।१५।
en: Having come to this (mutual) understanding, reposing confidence in each other, they all arrived at Kishkindha and desirous of battle remained prepared (for counter with Bali).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तां शमीमुपसंगम्य पार्थो वैराटिमब्रवीत्। सुकुमारं समाज्ञाय संग्रामे नातिकोविदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having approached the Shami tree and found out that the son of Virata was highly delicate and inexperienced in battle Partha said to him.

sa: एष वीरो महेष्वासः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। आगतः क्लीबवेषेण पार्थो नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: This great bowman, this best of heroes, who has come in the guise of a person of the ncuter sex is undoubtedly the son of Pritha.

sa: स च दुर्योधनो नूनं प्रेषयिष्यति सर्वशः। पूर्वाभिपन्नाः सन्तश्च भजन्ते पूर्वचोदनम्॥
en: Duryodhana, too will certainly send his messenger to all places and good men attend to those who send word first and who ask for help first.

sa: अधनाद्धि निवर्तन्ते ज्ञातयः सुहृदो द्विजाः। अपुष्पादफलाद् वृक्षाद् यथा कृष्ण पतत्रिणः॥
en: Form a man stricken with property do cousins, friends and Brahmanas turn away; as from a tree without flowers and fruits the winged creatures turn away.

sa: तत्रैषा परमा काष्ठा रौद्रकर्मक्षयोदया। यद् वयं कौरवान् हत्वा तानि राष्ट्राण्यवाप्नुमः॥
en: It is the greatest of all vicious deeds for us to prosper after this destruction-that we should obtain the kingdoms after slaying the sons of Kuru.

sa: मत्स्यो राजा रुक्मरथः सपुत्रः प्रहारिभिः सह पुत्रैविराटः। राजानश्च ये विजिताः पुरस्तात् त्वामेव ते संश्रयेयुः समस्ताः॥
en: And also (your followers) the king of the Matsya, Virata of the golden car with his son at the head of his shoulders. And the kings who were formerly vanquished by you, all have come over to your side.

sa: अयुद्ध्यमानो मनसाऽपि यस्य जयं कृष्णः पुरुषस्याभिनन्देत्। एवं सर्वान् स व्यतीयादमित्रान् सेन्द्रान् देवान् मानुषे नास्ति चिन्ता॥
en: That man whose victory is merely desired by Krishna, even if the latter does not fight, is sure to triumph over all enemies though they be the gods themselves with Indra. If they are men, there is no anxiety.

sa: तेजस्वी च महात्मा च युद्धे चामितविक्रमः। ग्रसेत् त्रिभुवन् सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्॥
en: He is spirited large minded and of unparalleled prowess in battle and he will absorb all the three worlds with all their gods, Asuras and men.

sa: अपि द्रोणकृपौ वीरौ भीष्मकर्णावथो पुनः। अथवा सर्व एवैते तिष्ठन्तु वसुधाधिपाः॥
en: Even including Drona and Kripa, or the heroes Bhishma or Kuru or all those rulers of the earth assembled together even, if they stand against you.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवः प्राच्योदीच्या महीक्षितः। शतशो यानुपाश्रित्य धर्मराजो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: These and many others come from the countries in the east and the north depending on hundreds of them the king Dharma is prepared for battle.

sa: ब्राह्मणा हि महाभागाः पूजिताः पृथिवीपते। तारणाय समर्थाः स्युर्विपरीते वधाय च॥
en: The Brahmanas, O lord of the earth, are highly fortunate and when pleased are capable of bestowing salvation. But if displeased, they become (instruments) for destruction.

sa: ध्रुवं विनाशो युद्धेन क्षत्रियाणां प्रदृश्यते॥ ज्योतींषि न प्रकाशन्ते दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः।
en: Forsooth this presages a great destruction of the Kshatriyas in battle; the shining objects do not come in view and the birds and beasts appear frightful.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत आश्वासयामास पुत्राधिभिरभिप्लुताम्। पितृष्वसारं शोचन्ती शौरिः पार्थसखः पृथाम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Shauri, the friend of the Partha's, then comforted his paternal aunt Pritha who was lamenting being filled with grief on account of her sons.

sa: तस्य जिष्णुरुपावृत्य ध्वजं मूलादपातयत्। विकृष्य कलधौताप्रैः स विद्धः प्रापतद् भुवि॥
en: Then approaching him and drawing out a sharp arrow, Vishnu cut off with it the root of his banner. Struck down it fell on the ground.

sa: सप्त दोषाः सदा राज्ञा हतव्या व्यसनोदयाः। प्रायशो यैर्विनश्यन्ति कृतमूला अपीश्वराः॥
en: Seven defects which are the sources of calainity should also be avoided by a king since they always accomplish the destruction of even firmly established king.

sa: तौ गृहीत्वा च कौन्तेयो बाष्पमुत्सृज्य वीर्यवान्। ततः परमदुःखार्त इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The powerful son of Kunti, having held both of her hands in his own, began to shed tears, and stricken with great woe spoke the following.

sa: यस्तात न क्रुध्यति सर्वकालं भृत्यस्य भक्तस्य हिते रतस्य। तस्मिन् भृत्या भर्तरि विश्वसन्ति न चैनमापत्सु परित्यजन्ति॥
en: That master, O sire, who does not often get angry with his servants, that are devoted to him and bent on furthering his in crests, commands confidence from his servants, who do not forsake him in times of danger.

sa: पाञ्चालान् येन संग्रामे भीमसेनोऽजयत् प्रभुः। प्रत्यषेधद् बहूनेकः सपत्नांश्चैव दिग्जये॥ निशम्य यस्य विस्फारं व्यद्रवन्त रणात् परे। पर्वतस्येव दीर्णस्य विस्फोटमशनेरिव॥ सैन्धवं येन राजानं पर्यामृषितवानथ। ज्यापाशं धनुषस्तस्य भीमसेनोऽवतारयत्॥
en: The mighty Bhimasena unfastened the string of the bow with which the sinless one had conquered the Panchalas in fight, defeated the lord of Sindhu, opposed many of his foes alone at the time of spreading his conquest in all directions and hearing whose twang like the splitting of a mountain, or like the roar of the thunder, the enemies had fled from the field.

sa: विद्यमाने धने लोभाद् दानभोगविवर्जितः। पश्चान्नास्तीति यो ब्रूयात् सोऽक्षयं नरकं व्रजेत्॥
en: He also who has wealth, but who never enjoys it nor gives it away through avarice and says he has none, is doomed to eternal damnation.

sa: जानन्ति कुरवः सर्वे राजानश्चैव पार्थिवाः। शमे प्रयतमानं मां सर्वयत्नेन माधव॥
en: All the Kurus know, as also these kings, these rulers of the earth, that I have attempted to bring about peace with all earnestness, O Madhava.

sa: कान्तारे वनदुर्गेषु कृच्छ्रास्वापत्सु सम्भ्रमे। उद्येतेषु च शस्त्रेषु नास्ति सत्त्ववता भयम्॥
en: In deserts, foresees, in difficulties and calamities or when weapons are raised (by others to strike him) he who has a strong mind has no fear.

sa: समाहितेन चीर्णानि सर्वाण्येव व्रतानि मे। वायुभक्षोपवासश्च कृतो मे विधिवत् पुरा॥
en: I have observed all the vows with a devout spirit; and agreeably to the ordinances I have very often subsisted on air alone and observed fasts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कर्णेन राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। नैवोत्यातुं मनश्चक्रे स्वर्गाय कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Karna, king Duryodhana, being firmly resolved to die, determined not to rise from the place where he sat.

sa: न त्वन्यमभिगच्छेयं पुमांसं राघवादृते। इति जानीत सत्यं मे क्रियतां यदनन्तरम्॥
en: Than live with any other person except the descendant of Raghu. Know this to be my firm resolve; and now do, whatever you like, with me.”

sa: अवध्यानां वधं पश्यन् धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। निःश्वसन भीमसेनं च विजयं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: The virtuous king Yudhishthira, now seeing that a slaughter of innocent men was unavoidable, began to sign repeatedly and said these words to Bhimasena and Vijaya.

sa: प्रतिज्ञां वितयां कुर्यामिति राजन् पुनः पुनः। विशेषतस्त्वदर्थं च प्रतिज्ञां कृतवानहम्॥
en: Be false to my determination;" O king, I said this again and again and also said-"It was especially for your sake that I made that determination.

sa: प्रत्यक्षमेतद् भवतां यद् वक्ष्यामि हितं वचः। भवतामानुकूल्येन यदि रोचेत भारताः॥
en: What I shall tell you is clearly for your benefit, if in consequence of its being favourable to you it is approved by you, o Bharatas.

sa: इत्युक्ता सा प्ररुदती पर्यशङ्कत लक्ष्मणम्॥ हता वै स्त्रीस्वभावेन शुक्लचारित्रभूषणा। सा तं परुषमारब्धा वक्तुं साध्वी पतिव्रता॥
en: Thus addressed, she, who was weeping aloud, from the weakness natural to her sex, began to suspect Lakshmana adorned with a spotless character. And that chaste woman, devoted to her husband, began to level against Lakshmana these harsh words,

sa: यः सदेवान् मनुष्यांश्च सर्वांश्चैकरथोऽजयत्। सोऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य कन्यानां नर्तको युवा॥
en: Alas! that youthful one, who on a single car defeated all celestials and men, is now the dancing master of the daughters of the king Virata.

sa: ततः सभाया निर्गम्य सन्त्रयामास कौरवः। सौबलेन मताक्षेण राज्ञा शकुनिना सह॥
en: Then having issued out of the assemblyhall did that son of Kuru consult with the son of Subala, king Shakuni experienced in the game of dice.

sa: अथ चेत् कामसंयोगाद् द्वेषो लोभश्च लक्ष्यते। देवेषु दैवप्रामाण्यान्नैषां तद् विक्रमिष्यति॥
en: If however out of contact with desire, envy or avarice is observed in the action of gods; then owing to their own ruling it cannot prevail.

sa: जानन् मां किं महाबाहो सम्मोहयितुमिच्छसि। योऽयं पृथिव्याः कात्स्येन विनाशः समुपस्थितः॥
en: Knowing everything why do you wish to confound me and lead me to folly? You know that the destruction of the entire world is at hand.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं गतेषु पार्थेषु विसृष्टे च सुयोधने। आगते हास्तिनपुरं मोक्षिते पाण्डुनन्दनैः॥ भीष्मोऽब्रवीन्महाराज धार्तराष्ट्रमिदं वचः।
en: Vaishampayana said : O great king, when in this manner the Pandavas had gone away leaving Duryodhana and when having been rescued by the Pandavas, he had gone to Hastinapur, Bhishma spoke thus to the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana),

sa: तांस्तु सम्प्रस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः। लज्जया वीडितो राजञ्जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: Having seen them gone, Bhishma, the grandfather of the Kurus, bent down his head in shame. O king, he too then went away to his house,

sa: येषां दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषो ज्याघोषः श्रूयतेऽनिशम्। तेषां मां मानिनीं भार्यां सूतपुत्रः पदावधीत्॥
en: The son of a Suta has kicked me the beloved wife of those, the sounds of whose drums and twangs of whose bow are constantly heard.

sa: कथं हि भिन्नकरटं पद्मिनं वनगोचरम्। उपस्थाय महानागं करेणुः सूकरं स्पृशेत्॥
en: Is it possible for a she-elephant who has enjoyed the company of the mighty ranger of forest with rent temples, to live with a (miserable) hog?

sa: तां कीचकः प्रधावन्ती केशपाशे परामृशत्। अथैनां पश्यतो राज्ञः पातयित्वा पदावधीत्॥
en: Kichaka seized her by the locks while she was running with speed and struck her down by a kick in the very presence of the king.

sa: सा गृहीता विधुन्वाना भूमावाक्षिप्य कीचकम्। सभां शरणमागच्छद् यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having thus thrown Kichaka down on the ground while seized by him she ran trembling to the court, where the king Yudhishthira was, to seek protection.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च माद्रीपुत्रो यशस्विनौ। शामित्रं तौ महावी? सम्यक् तत्र भविष्यतः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva, the two sons of Madri endued with fame-these two heroes of great strength will be duly the sacrifices of animals in that sacrifice.

sa: सपताकं विचित्राङ्गं सोपासङ्गं महाबलम्। खात् पपात रथे तूर्णं दिव्यरूपं मनोरमम्॥
en: A celestial and charming flag-staff adorned with gold, furnished with a handsome banner and quivers attached to it, immediately fell on the car from the sky.

sa: नारद उवाच दुर्लभो वै सुहच्छ्रोता दुर्लभश्च हितः सुहृत्। तिष्ठते हि सुहृद् यत्र न बन्धुस्तत्र तिष्ठते॥
en: Narada said Race are those persons who listen to the advice of well-wishers and rare are friends who give good counsels, where there is an adviser who could advice well there is no friend standing (in need of it).

sa: सात्यकिरुवाच सत्यमाह महाबाहो सहदेवो महामतिः। दुर्योधनवधे शान्तिस्तस्य कोपस्य मे भवेत्॥
en: Satyaki said Sahadeva of large mind has spoken the truth, O you of long arms. His wrath and mine will be appeased only by killing Duryodhana.

sa: रोमकूपेषु च तथा सूर्यस्येव मरीचयः। तं दृष्ट्वा घोरमात्मानं केशवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: From the poor of his skin issued in the same way something like the rays of the sun; seeing that frightful appearance of the greatsouled Keshava.

sa: तानुवाचानतान् रामः प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः। अपि मां जीवयिष्यध्वमपि वः कृतकृत्यता॥
en: (Then) Rama, holding (in his hand) his bow together with arrows, addressed those assembled (monkeys) thus, “Will you make me bear life? Have you been successful?

sa: उक्तो मया वासुदेवः पुनः पुनरुपह्वरे। सम्बन्धिषु समां वृत्तिं वर्तस्व मधुसूदनः॥
en: Vasudeva was thus addressed by me again and again in private: “Behave with impartiality to those who are equally related to you, O slayer of Madhu.

sa: तृणप्रायं ज्वलनेनेव दग्धं ग्रामं यथा धार्तराष्ट्रान् समीक्ष्य। पक्वं सस्यं वैद्युतेनेव दग्धं परासिक्तं विपुलं स्वं बलौघम्॥
en: When like a village containing several huts of straw burnt up by fire, he sees the army of the son of Dhritarashtra consumed or when he sees his vast hosts of armies scattered like ripe corns struck by lightning.

sa: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि कृष्णे बाष्पो निगृह्यताम्। हतामित्रात्प्रिया युक्तानचिराद् द्रक्ष्यसे पतीन्॥
en: I tell you truly, O Krishna, stop your tears. You will ever (in future) see your husbands endued with prosperity and with all their enemies killed.

sa: किमिदं भवता प्राप्तमिहागमनजं फलम्। वासोऽयमिह कालं तु कियन्तं नौ भविष्यति॥
en: "What is this condition you find yourself in, as a result of your doing here, for what length of time shall we have to live here.

sa: ते भवन्तो यथाधर्मं यथासमयमेव च। प्रयच्छन्तु प्रदातव्यं मा व: कालोऽत्यगादयम्॥
en: Therefore do you, as dictated by virtue and as agreed to in the stipulation, give back that which should be returned. Don't you let this opportunity.

sa: महिमानं तु कृष्णस्य भूय एवाभिवर्धयन्। सुघोषः पतगेन्द्रेण ध्वजेन युयुजे रथः॥
en: And, as if enhancing the glory of Krishna, the chariot with flag was perched on with a loud noise by the chief of the fatherly creation.

sa: चिन्तयंश्च महातेजा गुणान् रामस्य वीर्यवान्। अभ्यभाषत भद्रं ते प्रीयमाणः पुरोहितम्॥ अद्य पुष्यो निशि ब्रह्मन् पुण्यं योगमुपैष्यति। सम्भाराः सम्भियन्तां मे रामश्चोपनिमन्त्र्यताम्॥
en: That highly energetic and powerful one (Dasharatha) thinking of the qualifications of Rama, was well-pleased and (thus) addressed his priest, "O Brahmana, this night the constellation Paushya being in the ascendant, will be a highly auspicious time. Let therefore my attendants collect materials (for the inauguration) and let Rama also be invited.”

sa: दैवतेषु प्रयत्नेन राजसु ब्राह्मणेषु च। नियन्तव्यः सदा क्रोधो वृद्धबालातुरेषु च।॥
en: The resentment against the gods, the king, the Brahmanas should ever be suppressed with an effort; as also that against old men, children and helpless person.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सहदेवोऽपि गोपानां कृत्वा वेषमनुत्तमम्। भाषां चैषां समास्थाय विराटमुपयादथ॥
en: Vaishampayana said Wearing an excellent dress of a cowherd and learning the dialect of the same, Saladeva also arrived at the city of the king Virata.

sa: धर्मज्ञेषु सभासत्सु नेह युक्तमसाम्प्रतम्। यत्र धर्मो ह्यधर्मेण सत्यं यत्रानृतेन च॥
en: In an assembly conversant with the rules of virtue, nothing improper should happen (but in one) in which vice prevails over virtue or falsehood over truth.

sa: एतच्छत्रात् परिभ्रष्टं सलिलं सोमनिर्मलम्। तमसा मूर्छितं भाति येन नार्छति दर्शनम्॥
en: The water, falling from this umbrella, is pure as the moon and yet is surrounded by such darkness that it cannot be grasped by the sight.

sa: श्रिया संतप्यमानेन पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। त्वया दुर्मन्त्रितं द्यूतं सौबलेन च भारत॥
en: Being jealous of the prosperity of the great-souled sons of Pandu you arranged for a game at dice consultation with the son of Subala, O Bharata.

sa: अस्त्राणामिव दिव्यानां प्रभावः सम्प्रयुज्यताम्। त्वया च कुरुभिश्चैव द्रवन्तीव दिशो दश॥
en: The ten quarters appear as if melting away on account of the effulgence of the celestials weapon used by you as well as by the Kurus.

sa: वासश्च परिधायैकं कृष्णा सुमलिनं महत्॥ कृत्वा वेषं च सैरन्ध्रयास्ततो व्यचरदार्तवत्। तां नराः परिघावन्ती स्त्रियश्च समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Having put on a very big dirty piece of cloth and dressed herself as a Sairandhri, Krishna began to ramble hither and thither like one in a miserable plight. All males and females came running to her wandering about.

sa: अश्वस्तनमृषीणां हि विद्यते वेद तद् भवान्। यं त्विमं धर्ममित्याहुर्धनादेष प्रवर्तते॥
en: To make no provision for the morrow is a practice that suits Rishis. You know this well! The religion of kings, however, depends entirely on wealth.

sa: वाग्देहमनसां शौचं क्षमा सत्यं धृतिः स्मृतिः। सर्वधर्मेषु धर्मज्ञा ज्ञापयन्ति गुणाञ्छुभान्॥
en: Purity of speech, of body, and of mind, forgiveness, truth, firmness and intelligence,-these good qualities are shown by pious persons who observe both kinds of religion.

sa: वातपित्तकफाद् रक्तं त्वडमांसं स्नायुमस्थि च। मज्जां देहं शिराजालैस्तर्पयन्ति रसा नृणाम्॥
en: The different sorts of juices, passing through the network of arteries, nourish men's wind, bile, phlegm, blood, skin, flesh, intestines, bones, marrow, and the whole body.

sa: पुरा हि कान्यकुब्जे वै गाधेः सत्यवतीं सुताम्। भार्यार्थेऽवरयत् कन्यामृचीकस्तेन भाषितः॥
en: In days of old, in Kanyakubja, Richika chose the damsel Satyavati, the daughter of Gadhi, for his wife and he was thus spoken to by Gadhi.

sa: को चोभौ कर्मणां मार्गों प्राप्नुयुर्दक्षिणोत्तरौ। प्रलयं चापवर्गं च भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययौ॥
en: By what action are the two paths, northern and southern, obtained? What is destruction? What, Liberation? What is birth and what death of all existent objects?

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच चिन्तयित्वा तदाश्चर्यं स्त्रिया प्रोक्तमशेषतः। विनिन्दन् स स्वमात्मानमागस्कृत इवाबभौ॥
en: Markandeya said : Continuously meditating upon that wonder, which the woman had told and reproaching himself very often, he appeared as if he was a criminal.

sa: एतेषां पृथगध्यास्ते यो धर्मं संशितव्रतः। कालात् पश्यति भूतानां सदैव प्रभवाप्ययौ॥
en: That persons of rigid vows who follows any one of these modes separately, always succeeds in time to understand the production and destruction of all creatures.

sa: अदृश्यं च मुहूर्तेन चकुस्ते भरतर्षभ। कृष्णेन सहितं युद्धे कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम्॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata, in a moment they, in that battle, made the son of Kunti namely Dhananjaya, together with Krishna, disappear from the sight.

sa: किमयं चार्यते बाजी स्त्रीमध्य इव भारत। ह्यमेनं हरिष्यामि प्रयतस्व विमोक्षणे॥
en: This horse of yours, O Bharata, seems to move about, protected by women only! I shall take away the horse. Do you try to free him.

sa: द्रौपदी च परिकिष्टा सभामध्ये रजस्वला। द्यूते यद् विजितो राजा शकुनेबुद्धिनिश्चयात्॥
en: Remember how Draupadi, while in her season, was maltreated in the midst of the assembly and how king Yudhishthira was defeated at dice through Shakuni's advice.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच पुष्कराद् यदि सम्भूतो ज्येष्ठं भवति पुष्करम्। ब्रह्माणं पूर्वजं चाह भवान् संदेह एव मे॥
en: Bharadwaja said If Brahman originated from the Lotus, then it is the Lotus that should be considered as the first-born and not Brahman. Why, however, is Brahman said to be the first? Do you dispel this doubt of mine.

sa: ततः पुष्करतः सृष्टः सर्वज्ञो मूर्तिमान् प्रभुः। ब्रह्मा धर्ममयः पूर्वः प्रजापतिरनुत्तमः॥
en: From the Lotus sprang first the Omniscient lord Brahman, endued with form, of the essence of Righteousness, and the Creator of all mobile and immobile things.

sa: ततो यथेष्टमगमत् पुनरेव स केसरी। ततः समुद्रतीरेण वङ्गान् पुण्ड्रान् सकोसलान्॥
en: The sacrificial horse then, having beautiful manes, proceeded at his will along the seacoast, going to the countries of the Bangas, the Pundras, and the Kosalas.

sa: यूयमिन्द्रसमाः सर्वे देवतुल्यपराक्रमाः। मा परेषां मुखप्रेक्षाः स्थेत्येवं तत् कृतं मया॥
en: You are all equal to Indra. Your prowess resembles that of the very celestials. I acted thus so that you might not live, depending upon others.

sa: यच्च किंचिदिह प्राणी चेष्टते शाल्मले भुवि। सर्वत्र भगवान् वायुश्चेष्टाप्राणकरः प्रभुः॥
en: The illustrious Wind-god is always the root of all the acts of creatures in this world, since it is he that is the giver of life.

sa: कालवालास्तु ये पार्थं दन्तवर्णावहन् हयाः॥ तैर्युक्तं रथमास्थाय प्रायाद् राजा पराङमुखः।
en: Riding on the car drawn by horses white as teeth and having black hairs which used to bear Partha the king fled away from the battle-field.

sa: स त्वं नारायणो भूत्वा हरिरासीः परंतप। ब्रह्मा सोमश्च सूर्यश्चधर्मोधाता यमोऽनलः॥ वायुर्वैश्रवणो रुद्रः कालः खं पृथिवी दिशः। अजश्चराचरगुरुः स्रष्टा त्वं पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: O chastiser of foes, having floated on Primordial waters, you subsequently became Hari, Brahma, Surya, Dharma, Dhatri, Yama, Anala. Vayu, Vaisravana, Rudra, Kala and the sky, the earth, the air and the directions. O foremost of Purushas, you are your own creator, you are the lord of all mobile and immobile universe.

sa: गच्छ गच्छेति गुरुणा सोऽनुज्ञातो वृकोदरः। ततः पाण्डुसुतो राजन् भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then Vrikodara was repeatedly urged on by lis elder brother, with the words “Proceed 'roceed.” Therefore o king, that highly juissant son of Pandu namely Bhimasena.

sa: सर्वभूतदयावन्तो अहिंसानिरताः सदा॥ परुषं च न भाषन्ते सदा सन्तो द्विजप्रियाः।
en: Those who, are king to all creatures and who are never malignant and who never speak ill of anybody, are always dear to the twice-born ones.

sa: अनन्यः पार्थ मत्तस्तवं त्वत्तश्चाहं तथैव च। नावयोरन्तरं शक्यं वेदितुं भरतर्षभ॥
en: O Partha, you are from me and I am from you. O best of the Bharata race, none can understand the difference that exists between us.

sa: धर्मवृत्तं हि राजानं प्रेत्य चेह च भारत। देवर्षिपितृगन्धर्वाः कीर्तयन्ति महौजसः॥
en: The gods, the Rishis, the Pitris, and the Gandharvas, possessed of great energy, chant the praises, both here and hereafter, of that king who is righteous!

sa: तस्मादर्थाच्च कामाच्च धर्म एवोत्तरो भवेत्। अस्मिल्लोके परे चैव धर्मात्मा सुखमेधते॥
en: Amongst these three objects, viz., Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure, Virtue is the foremost. He, who is of virtuous soul, acquires great happiness both here and hereafter.

sa: असदेव हि धर्मस्य प्रदानं धर्म आसुरः। नानुशुश्रुम जात्वेतामिमां पूर्वेषु कर्मसु॥
en: The impious violation of eternal practice is considered as the practice of the Asuras. We never hear of such practice in the conduct of the ancients.

sa: यः सर्वेषां भवति ह्यर्चनीय उत्सेधनस्तम्भ इवाभिजातः। यस्मै वाचं सुप्रसन्नां वदन्ति स वै देवान् गच्छति संयतात्मा॥
en: A person of controlled soul, who becomes the object of worship with all by becoming the foremost of the pillars of the universe, and to whom only agreeable words are addressed by all, acquires the companionship of the gods.

sa: रसज्ञाने तु जिह्वयं व्याहते वाक् तथोच्यते। इन्द्रियैर्विविधैर्युक्तं सर्वं व्यक्तं मनस्तथा॥
en: In the perception of taste, the Mind becomes the tongue, and in speech Mind become words. Covered with the different senses, Mind becomes all the objects.

sa: वासुदेवः परमिदं विश्वस्य ब्रह्मणो मुखम्। सत्यं ज्ञानमथो यज्ञस्तितिक्षा दम आर्जवम्॥
en: Vasudeva is the Supreme (cause) of the universe. He is the origin of the Vedas (viz., Om). He is Truth, Knowledge, Sacrifice, Renunciation, self-control, and Righteousness.

sa: अनेन तु प्रकारेण भूयो भूयश्च प्रज्वलन्। सप्तकृत्वः प्रशमितः खाण्डवे हव्यवाहनः॥
en: Thus Agni blazed forth again and again in the Khandava (forest), but the blazing fire was again and again extinguished by the dwellers of that forest.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नष्ट धने वा दारे वा पुत्रे पितरि वा मृते। अहो दुःखमिति ध्यायशोकस्यापचितिं चरेत्॥
en: Bhishma said, When one's wealth is lost, or one's wife or son or father is dead, he certainly says to oneself,-Alas, it is a great sorrow,-But then one should, by the help of meditation, try to kill that grief.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच प्राप्य राज्यं महाबाहुर्धर्मपुत्रौ युधिष्ठिरः। यदन्यदकरोद् विप्र तन्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Janamejaya said You should, O learned Brahmana, tell me what was next done by Yudhishthira the mighty-armed son of Dharma after he had regained his kingdom.

sa: वने काश्चिज्जले काश्चित् काश्चिद् वेश्मनु चाङ्गनाः। यथायोग्यं यथाप्रीति चिक्रीडुः पार्थकृष्णयोः॥
en: Some sported at their pleasure in the woods, some in the waters and some within the houses as directed and commanded by Krishna and Partha (Arjuna).

sa: स तु नागो द्विपरथान् हयांश्चामृद्य मारिष। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय ततः क्रुद्धो धनंजयः॥
en: The elephant, O sire, trampling down upon other elephants, cars and steeds, sent them all to the regions of Death. Thereat Dhananjaya was inflamed with wrath.

sa: श्रुत्वा हि निर्जितान् द्यूते पाण्डवान् मधुसूदनः। त्वरितः काम्यके पार्थान् समभावयदच्युतः॥
en: Having heard the defeat at dice of the Pandavas, the slayer of Madhu, that hero of imperishable fame, went at once to the forest of Kamyaka.

sa: धनूंष्यश्वान् नियन्तुंश्च ध्वजान् बाहूंच साङ्गदान्। शिरांसि च शितैर्बाणैस्तेषां चिच्छेद फाल्गुनिः॥
en: The son of Phalguna with sharp broadheaded shafts, cut-off their bows, their steeds, their charioteers, their standards and arms with bracelets and also their graceful heads.

sa: सुपार्श्व भीमसेनस्य जातरूपग्रहं धनुः। येन पार्थोऽजयत् कृत्स्नां दिशं प्राची परंतपः॥
en: That bow of beautiful sides and golden handle belongs to Bhima with which, the son of Pritha, the slayer of enemies, conquered the entire eastern region.

sa: तथा त्वमपि कौन्तेय शममास्थाय पुष्कलम्। तपसा सिद्धिमन्विच्छ योगसिद्धिं च भारत॥
en: O son of Kunti, O descendant of Bharata, therefore you too like them, entirely renouncing actions with motive, try to obtain success in Yoga and austerities.

sa: स तु राजा निराहारः सभार्य: कुरुनन्दन। पर्युपासत तं हृष्टश्च्यवनाराधने रतः॥
en: The king, O delighter of the Kurus, abstaining from food, along with his wife, sat joyfully the whole time, engaged in tending and serving the Rishi.
