sa: स तं सम्पूज्य तेजस्वी मुनि पृथुललोचनः। पूजितस्तेन च तदा पर्यपृच्छदनामय॥
en: The hero of large eyes and grcat energy adored that ascetic. He was then adored by the ascetic in return Vasudeva then enquired after his well-being.

sa: जाह्नवीतीरसम्भूतां मृदं मूर्धा बिभर्ति यः। बिभर्ति रूपं सोऽर्कस्य तमोनाशाय निर्मलम्॥
en: He who bears on his head the mud taken from the banks of Ganga looks effulgent like the sun himself bent on removing the surrounding darkness.

sa: ततः शत्रुवधं कृत्वा सुमहान्तं रणे पितः॥ दौहित्रस्तव वार्ष्णेय दौःशासनिवशं गतः।
en: Then, O father, after he had killed a very large number of enemies in battle, your daughter's son at last succumbed to the son of Dushasana.

sa: यो गोशतं कनकशृङ्गमयं ददाति विप्राय वेदविदुषे च बहुश्रुताय। दिव्यां च भारतकथां कथयेच नित्यं तुल्यं फलं भवति तस्य च तस्य चैव॥
en: That man who makes a present of a hundred kine with their horns covered with plate of gold to a Brahmana gifted with much learning and wellconversant with the Vedas, and he who causes the excellent Bharata story to be recited in his house every day, are said to acquire equal merits.

sa: बृहस्पतिर्याजयतां महेन्द्र देवश्रेष्ठं वज्रभृतां वरिष्ठम्। संवर्तो मां याजयिताऽद्य राजन् न ते वाक्यं तस्य वा रोचयामि॥
en: Let Brihaspati (therefore) officiate as priest to that Mahendra the supreme Deva (god), the highest one holding the thunderbolt, and, O prince, Samvarta will act as my priest, as neither his (Indra's) words, nor thine commend themselves to me.

sa: श्रीश्च बुद्धिश्च तेजश्च विभूतिश्च प्रतापिनी। स्वाध्याये चैव माहात्म्यं विपुलं प्रतिपत्स्यते॥
en: By Vedic study he is sure to acquire prosperity, intelligence, energy and power competent to scorch all things, as also glory of the most superior kind.

sa: भरणीषु द्विजातिभ्यस्तिलधेनुं प्रदाय वै। गा: सुप्रभूताः प्राप्नोति नरः प्रेत्य यशस्तथा॥
en: By making, under the constellation Bharani, a gift to the Brahmanas of kine and. sesame, one attains in his next life great fame and abundant kine.

sa: एतत् सर्वमशेषेण पितामह यथातथम्। वेत्तुमिच्छामि धर्मज्ञ परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: I wish to know all this, O grandfather, in sooth and in particular, O you, who are conversant with all the scriptures Great is my curiosity.

sa: शयनानि महार्हाणि वासांस्याभरणानि च। राजार्हाणि च सर्वाणि भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यनेकशः॥ युधिष्ठिरो महाराज धृतराष्ट्रेऽभ्युपाहरत्। तथैव कुन्ती गान्धार्यो गुरुवृत्तिमवर्तत॥
en: Yudhishthira gave the king costly beds, dresses and ornaments, and food and drink and other enjoyable articles, in profusion and of such superior kinds as were worthy of royal use. Likewise Kunti behaved towards Gandhari as towards a senior.

sa: धेन्वाः प्रमाणेन समप्रमाणां धेनुं तिलानामपि च प्रदाया पानीयदाता च यमस्य लोके न यातनां काञ्चिदुपैति तत्र॥
en: are Kine are sacred. They are the foremost of all things in the world. They are indeed the refuge of the universe. They are the mothers of the very celestials. They indeed incomparable. They should be dedicated in sacrifices.

sa: पूथिवीं गाश्च दत्त्वेह यच्चान्यदपि किंचन। विशिष्यते सुवर्णस्य दानं परमकं विभो॥
en: The gift of gold, O powerful king, is the highest gift. It is superior to the gift of earth, of kine, and of all other things.

sa: आज्यानि यजमानेभ्यस्तथानानि च भारत। अश्ववन्ति च यानानि वेश्मानि शयनानि च॥
en: Do you give to sacrificing Brahmanas clarified butter as also food, and cars and vehicles with horses harnessed thereto, and dwelling houses and mansions and beds.

sa: एतादिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं त्वत्तः कुरुकुलोद्वह। कात्स्येन तारकवधं परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: Operpetuator of Kuru's race, I wish to hear this from you, I mean the details of Taraka's destruction. Great is my curiosity to hear the narrative.

sa: ततः प्रजज्ञे निनदः सूतानां युज्यतामिति॥ उष्ट्राणां क्रोशतां चापि हयानां हेषतामपि।
en: Then loud sounds were heard, uttered by the charioteers that said, “Yoke, yoke,' as also of camels that granted aloud and of horses that neighed briskly.

sa: इदं तु शृणु राजेन्द्र कीर्त्यमानं मयानध। अभक्षणे सर्वसुखं मांसस्य मनुजाधिप॥
en: Listen to me, O king of kings, as I tell you this, O sinless one, There is absolute happiness ! in abstaining from meat, O king.

sa: तान् प्रहस्य महाबाहुः पुनरेव व्यवस्थितान्। ततः प्रोवाच कौन्तेयो मुमूर्षुश्लक्ष्णया गिरा।
en: The mighty-armed hero, laughing at his enemies, who had once more rallied but who were on the point of death, addressed them in these soft words.

sa: यन्मात्सर्यमयं भीमः करोति भृशदुःखितः। न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यमिति वाच्यः स पार्थिवः॥
en: You shall also tell the king that he should not suffer his heart to remember this show of pride in which Bhima, deeply afflicted, has indulged.

sa: एष योत्स्यामि सर्वांस्तु निवार्य शरवागुराम्॥ तिष्ठध्वं युद्धमनसो दर्प शमयितास्मि वः।
en: See, I fight all of you, baffling your clouds of arrows! Bent as you are on battle, wait a little. I shall soon quell your pride.

sa: शोभार्थं चापरान यूपान् काञ्चनान् भरतर्षभ। स भीमः कारयामास धर्मराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: At the bchest of the king, Bhima caused some other stakes to be set up, for the sake of beauty only which were made of goid.

sa: गतिज्ञः सर्वभूतानां भाषाज्ञश्च शरीरिणाम्। सर्वज्ञः स तदा दृष्ट्वा कीटं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The Rishi knew the of every creature and the language of every animal, Gifted with omniscience, he addressed the worm he saw in these words. course

sa: तांस्तु सर्वान् परिग्लानान् विदित्वा धृतराष्ट्रजा।॥ दुःशला बालमादाय नप्तारं प्रययौ तदा।
en: Then Dushala, their queen, the daughter of Dhritarastra, knowing that they were rendered cheerless by Arjuna, took her grandson in her arms and went to Arjuna.

sa: पुत्रशोकसमाविष्टो निःश्वसन् ह्येष भूमिपः। न शेते वसतीः सर्वा धृतराष्ट्रो महामुने॥
en: Afflicted with grief on account of the destruction of his his children, this king Dhritarashtra, always breathes heavily, and never sleeps at night, O great Rishi.

sa: आत्मवान् भव सुप्रीतः स्वधर्माचरणे रतः। क्षात्री तनुं समुत्सृज्य ततो विप्रत्वमेष्यसि॥
en: Be you of purified soul, be contented and be devoted to the practice of virtue. Acting thus, you will then, when you die, become a Brahmana.

sa: एताभिः सह सम्मन्त्र्य प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः। प्रभवन् योऽनहंवादी स वै पुरुष उच्यते॥
en: After consulting them I shall describe the subject in duc order. That person who, though capable, is still free from egotism, is rightly called a Purusha.

sa: अपत्यं तेजसा युक्तं प्रवीरं जनय प्रभो। यद् भयं नोऽसुरात् तस्मान्नाशयेद्धव्यवाहन॥
en: O powerful one, do you beget a heroic son possessed of your power, who will remove, O bearer of sacrificial libations, our fears from that Asura.

sa: बलदेवं च दुर्धर्षं तथान्यान् वृष्णिपुङ्गवान्। एवं सम्भाषमाणौ तौ प्राप्तौ वारणसाह्वयम्॥
en: You shall also see the irresistible Baladeva and other chiefs of the Vrishni race!' This conversing with each other, the two reached the city of Hastinapur.

sa: धनं धान्यं प्रियान् दारान् यानं वासस्तथाद्भुतम्। श्रियं दृष्ट्वा मनुष्याणामसूयामि निरर्थकम्॥
en: I used to feel unreasonable envy at seeing other people's riches and corn, and wives held dear by them, and articles of drink, and good palaces.

sa: विस्मितश्चापि राजर्षिरिमां गाथां जगाद ह। अहो कष्टं यदस्माभिः सर्वं बाह्यमनुष्ठितम्॥
en: Stricken with wonder, that royal sage then sang this verse : Alas it is a pity that we should have performed all acts that are external.

sa: ततो भगीरथी देवी तनयस्योदके कृते॥ उत्थाय सलिलात् तस्माद् रूदती शोकविहला।
en: After those oblations of water had been offered by them to her son the goddess Bhagirathi, rose up from the river, weeping and distracted by sorrow.

sa: कृष्णपक्षे तु यः श्राद्धं पितॄणामश्नुते द्विजः। अन्नमेतदहोरात्रात् पूतो भवति ब्राह्मणः॥
en: The Brahmana who partakes of oblations offered to departed Manes, in course of the dark fortnight, is purified by fasting for a whole day and night.

sa: देवाश्चाप्यस्य नाश्नन्ति पापस्य ब्राह्मणद्विषः। ब्राह्मणेषु तु तुष्टेषु प्रीयन्ते पितरः सदा॥
en: The gods also never eat in the house of the wretch who hates the Brahmanas. When the Brahmanas are pleased, the departed manes are also pleased.

sa: ततः स परिहीणोऽभूत् सुरेन्द्रो बलदर्पतः। धूपदीपोदक विधिं न यथावच्चकार ह॥
en: The king of the celestials, on account of his abstention from observing the ordinances about the offers of incense and light, began to decline in power.

sa: सावित्री ब्रह्मणः साध्वी कौशिकस्य शची सती। मार्कण्डेयस्य धूमोर्णा ऋद्धिर्वैश्रवणस्य च॥
en: Savitri is the chaste wife of Brahman. The caste Shachi is the wife of Indra. Dhumorna is the wife of Markandeya, and Riddhi of (king) Vaishravana.

sa: नामास्याः प्रियदत्तेति गृह्यं देव्याः सनातनम्। दानं वाप्यथवाऽऽदानं नामास्याः प्रथमं प्रियम्॥
en: This is an eternal and secret name of earth. viz., Priyadatta. Given away or accepted in gift, the name that is dear to her is Priyadatta.

sa: वध्यमानेषु तेष्वाजौ गान्धारेषु समन्ततः॥ स राजा शकुनेः पुत्रः पाण्डवं प्रत्यवारयत्।
en: When the Gandhara warriors were thus being killed all around him in battle, the royal son of Shakuni came forward to resist the son of Pandu.

sa: यश्च श्राद्ध कुरुते सङ्गत्तानि न देवयानेन पथा स याति। स वै मुक्तः पिप्पलं बन्धनाद् वा स्वर्गाल्लोकाच्च्यवते श्राद्धमित्रः॥ तस्मान्मित्रं श्राद्धकृन्नाद्रियेत दद्यान्मित्रेभ्यः संग्रहार्थं धनानि। यन्मन्यते नैव शत्रु न मित्रं तं मध्यस्थं भोजयेद्धव्यकव्य॥
en: He who collects his friends and relatives only on the occasion of the Shraddha he performs, fails to proceed (after death) by the celestial path. The man who converts the Shraddha he performs, into an occasion for only collecting his friends, never succeeds in ascending to Heaven. The man who converts the Shraddha into an occasion for treating his friends, becomes alienated from Heaven even like a bird dissociated from the perch when the chain tying it breaks.

sa: आदिर्विश्वस्य जगतो विष्णुर्ब्रह्ममयो महान्। भूतं परतरं यस्मात् त्रैलोक्ये नेह विद्यते॥
en: The great Vishnu, who is full of Brahma, than whom there is no higher being in the three worlds is the first of all the universe.

sa: नास्य पापं प्रभवति न च पापेन लिप्यते। पठेद् वा श्रावयेद् वापि श्रुत्वा वा लभते फलम्॥
en: Sin can never lord over him. Indeed, such a man can never be stained with faults of any sort. Indeed, one acquires profuse merits by reading these mysteries or by reciting them to others or by hearing them recited.

sa: ततो लाजैः सुमनोभिश्च राजा विचित्राभिस्तद् गृहं पूजयित्वा। सम्यूज्याथै त्यवर्गं च सर्वे ततः समुत्सृज्य ययौ नरेन्द्रः॥
en: The king adored the palace in which he had lived with fried paddy and excellent flowers of various kinds. He also honoured all his servants with gifts of wealth, and then leaving that house set out on his journey.

sa: क्षात्राद् बलाद् ब्रह्मवलं गरीयो न ब्रह्मतः किंचिदन्यद् गरीयः। सोऽहं जानन् ब्रह्मतेजो यथावन्न संवर्त जेतुमिच्छामि शक्र॥
en: The power of Brahmana,s O Shakra, is greater than that of the Kshatriyas, none are more powerful than Brahmanas and knowing duly, as I do, the power of Brahmanas I do not, O Shakra, wish to quarrel with Samvarta.

sa: तदेवं शोकहर्षी तु कामद्वेषौ च पुत्रका अतिमानातिवादौ च प्रविशेते द्विजाधमम्॥
en: While wandering in that existence, joy and grief, desire and hatred vanity and evil speech, scck to enter into him and make a wretch of him.

sa: यो ह्यस्य पार्थिवो भाग-पृथिवीं स गमिष्यति। यदस्य वारिज किंचिदपस्तत् सम्प्रवेक्ष्यति॥
en: That part of this animal which is of earth will go to earth. That part of this one which is of water, will enter into water.

sa: तमध्वर्युः प्रत्युवाच नायं छागो विनश्यति। श्रेयसा योक्ष्यते जन्तुर्यदि श्रुतिरियं तथा॥
en: To him the Adhvaryu replied. This goat will not be destroyed. The animal meets with great good, if the Vedic declaration on this subject be true.

sa: शुन:सख उवाच एभिरुक्तं यथा नाम नाहं वक्तुमिहोत्सहे। शुन:सखसखायं मां यातुधान्युपधारय॥
en: Shunasakha said I cannot explain the etymology of my name like these ascetics. But know, O Yatudhani, that I am called by the name of Shunasakha.

sa: प्रतिबुद्धस्तु स मुनिस्तौ प्रोवाच विशाम्पते। तैलाभ्यङ्गो दीयतां मे स्त्रास्येऽहमिति भारत॥
en: Awaking then from his sleep the ascetic addressed the king and the queen, saying-do you rub my body with oil, I wish to have a bath.

sa: दिष्ट्या नाभिभवन्ति त्वां दैवस्तेऽयमनुग्रहः। यत् ते भृशतरं दानाद् वर्तयिष्यामि तच्छृणु॥
en: This favour done to you is due to kindness of the celestials. Listen to me, as I describe to you what is even superior to gift.

sa: बलेः कुम्भीनसेश्चैव सर्वास्ता योषितो विदुः। हसन्तं प्रहसन्त्येता रुदन्तं प्ररुदन्ति च॥
en: If man laughs, women laugh. If man weeps, they weep. If the opportunity requires, they receive the man who is disagreeable to them with sweet words.

sa: विसोमा इव शर्वर्यो विपुष्पास्तरवो यथा। तद्वद् देशा दिशश्चैव हीना गङ्गाजलैः शिवैः॥ वर्णाश्रमा यथा सर्वे धर्मज्ञानविवर्जिताः। क्रतवश्च यथासोमास्तथा गङ्गां विना जगत्॥
en: The countries and the points of the compass which are destitute of the sacred waters of Ganga are like nights without the moon or trees without flowers. Indeed a world without Ganga is like the different castes and modes of life when they are shorn of virtue or like sacrifices without Soma.

sa: शशलोमा च राजाऽऽसीद् राजन् परमधार्मिकः। सम्यगस्मिन् वने तप्त्वा ततो दिवमवाप्तवान्॥
en: There was another king, highly righteous, of the name of Shashaloman. He, too, performed severe austerities in this forest and then ascended to the celestial region.

sa: व्यास उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु नृपतिर्मरुत्तो व्रीडितोऽभवत्। प्रत्यागच्छन् सुसंविग्नो ददर्श पथि नारदम्॥
en: Vyasa said Thus told, king Marutta became confounded with shame, and while returning home with his mind stricken with anxiety, he met Narada on his way,

sa: वर्धमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्रार्थयामास तारकः। उपायैर्बहुभिर्हन्तुं नाशकच्चापि तं विभुम्॥
en: Seeing the son of Agni grow up, Taraka sought, by various means, to bring about his destruction, but could not do anything to that powerful deity.

sa: सुसूक्ष्मं च व्यलीकं ते सपुत्रस्य न विद्यते। यत् तु ज्ञातिविमर्देऽस्मिन्नात्थ दुर्योधनं प्रति॥ भवन्तमनुनेष्यामि तत्रापि कुरुनन्दन।
en: The slightest omission cannot be laid at your doors and yours sons. Regarding what you have said about Duryodhana in the matter of this destruction of kinsmen, I beg you, O delighter of the Kurus, (to listen to me).

sa: हन्त निःश्रेयसं जन्तोरहं वक्ष्याम्यनुत्तमम्। अहिंसापाश्रयं धर्मं यः साधयति वै नरः॥
en: I shall tell you what forms the highest good of a human being. That man who practises the religion of universal mercy, acquires his highest good.

sa: भार्या समभवद् यस्य नर्मदा सरितां वरा। सोऽस्मिन्नरण्ये नृपतिस्तपस्तप्त्वा दिवं गतः॥
en: That foremost of rivers, viz., Narmada, became the consort of that king. Having practised penances in this very forest, that king procceded to the celestial region.

sa: रामः सुवर्णं दत्त्वा हि विमुक्तः सर्वकिल्विषैः। त्रिविष्टपे महत् स्थानमवापासुलभं नरैः॥
en: By making gifts of gold, Rama became purged of all his sins, and finally acquired a high place in Heaven that is unattainable by other men.

sa: प्राप्नुवन्ति महात्मान इति वित्त द्विजर्षभाः। अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि नियतं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
en: Indeed, those great ones attain to the highest seat. Understand this, you foremost of twice-born ones! I shall after this describe the eternal characteristics of duties.

sa: एतत्ते कथितं तात यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। दर्शने यादृशः स्नेहः संवासे वा युधिष्ठिर॥ महाभाग्यं गवां चैव तथा धर्मविनिश्चयम्। किं भूयः कथ्यतां वीर किं ते हदि विवक्षितम्॥
en: I have thus, O son, told you everything about what you had asked me. The affection that is caught by the sight alone of others as also by the fact of living with them, O Yudhishthira, and the high blessedness of kine too, and the ascertainment of true virtue, are the subject I have described. Tell me, O hero what else is in your mind.

sa: ततस्तानजयत् सर्वान् प्रातिसीमान् नराधिपान्। एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन् विश्रुतः स करन्धमः॥
en: And then he defeated all the kings living along the borders of his dominions And from this incident, O king, he hath been celebrated as Karandhama.

sa: राजनीति: सुबहुशः श्रुता : सुबहुशः श्रुता ते भरतर्षभ। संदेष्टव्यं ने पश्यामि कृतं मे भवता विभो॥
en: O chief of Bharata's race, you have repeatedly heard what the duties are of kings. I do not see what more I can say to you. I have no longer any necessity with you, O you of great power.

sa: अष्टौ कविसुता ह्येते सर्वमेभिर्जगत् ततम्। प्रजापतय एते हि प्रजाभागैरिह प्रजाः॥
en: These are the eight sons of Kavi. By them the whole world has been peopled. They are all called Prajapatis, and they have procreated many offspring.

sa: नीरजातेन हि बिना न किंचित् सम्प्रवर्तते॥ नीरजातश्च भगवान् सोमो ग्रहगणेश्वरः।
en: Nothing can exist without the help of what comes from water. The very lord of all the planets, viz., the illustrious Soma, has originated from water.

sa: नोत्थापयामि भर्तारं सुखसुप्तमहं सदा। आन्तरेष्वपि कार्येषु तेन तुष्यति मे मनः॥
en: When my husband sleeps in peace I never awake him even if important business wanted his attention. I was happy to sit by him lying asleep.

sa: राज्यं पृथिव्यां सर्वस्यामथवापि त्रिविष्टपे। तथा बुद्धिरियं वेत्ति बुद्धिरेव धनं मम॥
en: Sovereignty over the whole Earth or over the Heaven can be compared with this knowledge of my oneness with the universe). This knowledge is my wcalth.

sa: एकः पन्था ब्राह्मणानां येन गच्छन्ति तद्विदः। गृहेषु वनवासेषु गुरुवासेषु भिक्षुषु॥
en: This is the one path for Brahmanas by which they who understand it proceed domesticity, or abodes in the forest, or residence with preceptors, among mendicants.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं श्रेयः पुरुषस्येह किं कुर्वन् सुखमेधते। विपाप्मा स भवेत् केन किं वा कल्मषनाशनम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said What, indeed, is beneficial for a person in this world? What is that by doing which one may acquire happiness? By what may one be purged of all his sins? Indeed, what is that which destroys sins?

sa: नाननुज्ञातभूमिर्हि यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते। त्वं हि सर्वस्य जगतः स्थावरस्य चरस्य च॥
en: The person who has not got by lawful means the earth whereon to make the sacrificial altar, acquires not the merit of the sacrifice he performs.

sa: ततः संहृत्य तत् तेजः प्रोवाचोत्तङ्कमीश्वरः। एष्टव्ये सति चिन्त्योऽहमित्युक्त्वा द्वारकां ययौ॥
en: Withdrawing that energy, the Supreme Lord then said to Utanka, Whenever you will require water, think of me!' Having said so, he proceeded towards of Dwraka.

sa: कस्मिंश्चिच्च पुरा शैब्येन शिबिसूनुना। दक्षिणार्थेऽथ ऋत्विग्भ्यो दत्तः पुत्रः पुरा किल॥
en: At a sacrifice which had been performed formerly by Shibi's son, he had given away to the Ritviks a son of his as the sacrificial present.

sa: स्वभावश्चैव नारीणां नराणामिह दूषणम्। अत्यर्थं न प्रसज्जन्ते प्रमदासु विपश्चितः ॥
en: The disposition of women is such that man's contact with her produces misery. Hence, wise men do not allow themselves to be excessively attached to women.

sa: न ते शक्या दरिद्रेण यज्ञाः प्राप्तुं पितामह। बहूपकरणा यज्ञा नानासम्भारविस्तराः॥
en: It should be remembered, however, O grandfather, that Sacrifices are incapable of being celebrated by poor men, for these require a large store of various articles.

sa: पापान प्रवर्धतो दृष्ट्वा कल्याणानावसीदतः। ध्रुवं गर्हयसे नित्यं तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Seeing sinful persons multiplying on every side and virtue languishing, you are filled with grief. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: स्तोतव्या चेह पृथिवी निवापस्येह धारिणी। वैष्णवी काश्यपी चेति तथैवहाक्षयेति च॥
en: The Earth also, as the goddess who sustains the offerings made at Shraddhas, should then be lauded under the names of Vaishnavi, Kashyapi, and the inexhaustible,

sa: इति त्वमनुजानीहि राम मा क्षत्रियान् जहि। तपो घोरमुपातिष्ठ ततः श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे॥
en: Do you know this, O Rama! Cease, to kill the Kshatriyas! Do you practise the austerest of penances! You will then attain to what is good.

sa: द्रौपदी च सुभद्रा च याश्चान्याः पाण्डवस्त्रियः। समां वृत्तिमवर्तन्त तयोः श्वश्वोर्यथाविधि॥
en: Draupadi and Subhadra and the other ladies of the Pandavas treated the old king and the queen as if they were their own father-in-law and mother-in-law.

sa: ये रणाग्रे महीपालाः शूराः समितिशोभनाः। वध्यन्तेऽभिमुखाः शक्र ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजन्ति ते॥
en: Those heroic kings and ornaments of assemblies who give their lives in battle with faces towards the foe, attain, O Shakra, to the region of Brahman.

sa: तेषां तत्र कथा दिव्या धर्मिष्ठाश्चाभवन् नृप। ऋषीणां च पुराणानां देवासुरविमिश्रिताः॥
en: The conversation which then arose was excellent and had reference to subjects, connected with piety, and the Rishis of old, and the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: तन्निर्याणे दुःखितः पौरवर्गो गजाह्वये चैव बभूव राजन्! यथा पूर्वं गच्छतां पाण्डवानां द्यूते राजन् कौरवाणां सभाया:॥
en: At Dhritarashtra's departure, O king, all the citizens of Hastinapur became as distressed as they had been, O monarch, when they had seen the departure of the Pandavas in former days after their defeat at the match at dice.

sa: सोऽभ्यगात् सह पुड्वेन वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः। विनिर्मिद्य च कौन्तेयं प्रविवेश महीतलम्॥
en: Equipped with feathers, that penetrated Arjuna's body like snake penetrating on an anthill. Piercing the son of Kunti through, the arrow went deep into the Earth.

sa: अन्योन्यस्य वधे यत्नं कुर्वाणौ तौ महारथौ॥ रथाभ्यां चेरतुस्तत्र मण्डलानि सहस्रशः।
en: Those two most powerful car-warriors, who made efforts in slaying each other, whirled round upon their cars, thereby creating thousands of circle, there (in the battle).

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे पार्थः संवृतस्तैर्महारथैः॥ निगृहीतं रथं दृष्ट्वा केशवं चाप्यभिद्रुतम्।
en: Surrounded by those mighty car-warriors and beholding his car assailed and thus Keshava attacked, Partha, boiling with rage, overthrew a large number of car-warriors and foot-soldiers.

sa: न तु तावदहं मन्ये प्राप्तकालं तवानघ। समागमं महाबाहो सूतपुत्रेण संयुगे॥
en: O sinless one, I do not think that the hour has come when, O mighty armed one, you should meet the son of Suta in battle.

sa: द्राव्यमाणं बलं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनेन धीमता। यन्तारमब्रवीत कर्णः पञ्चालानेव मां वह॥
en: Karna, on observing that his army was being routed by the highly intelligent Bhimasena, asked his driver once more to drive on direct to the Panchalas.

sa: रामस्य तु समः शस्त्रे पुरंदरसमो युधि। कार्तवीर्यसमो वीर्य बृहस्पतिसमो मतौ॥
en: In knowledge of weapons, Ashvatthaman is like Rama himself; in battle he is like Purandar, in prowess he equals Kartavirya and in wisdom hc matches Brihaspati.

sa: एकमेव हि लोकेऽस्मिन्नात्मनो गुणवत्तरम्। इच्छन्ति पुरुषाः पुत्रं लोके नान्यं कथंचन॥
en: There is only one person in the world whom people can desire to be superior to themselves in accomplishments and that person is one's own son.

sa: के चास्य पृष्ठतोऽन्वासन् वीरा वीरस्य योधिनः। के पुरस्तादवर्तन्त रथिनस्तस्य शत्रवः॥
en: Who were the heroes that guarded the rear of that warrior engaged in fight? Who were the enemies that were stationed in front of that carwarrior?

sa: तमापतन्तं चिच्छेद राधेयः प्रहसन्निवा त्रिभिः शरैः शरं राजन् पाण्डवस्य प्रतापवान्॥
en: The son of Radha, however, O king, smilingly cut-off that dart of Pandu's son as it flew through the sky with three shafts of his Own.

sa: स्वरथं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा युद्धायैव व्यवस्थितः। तद् विहत्यास्य राधेयस्तत एनं समभ्ययात्॥
en: Remained on the field, keeping his car behind him and firmly resolved to continue that battle. In that combat, the son of Radha once more rushed.

sa: सोऽहं तेनैव वीरेण समरेष्वपलायिना। सहयः सरथः पार्थ जित्वा जीवन् विसर्जितः॥
en: O Partha, with my horses and cars I was vanquished by Karna, who never retreats from the battle-field. He simply let me go with my life.

sa: अत्र सर्वे महाराज त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥ सैन्धवस्य रणे रक्षा विधिवत् कर्तुमर्हथ।
en: For these reasons, O mighty monarch, it behoves us all to effect the protection of the Sindhu king at the very cost of our own lives.

sa: त्वत्कृते व्यचरत् संख्ये स तु षोडशवर्षवत्। उक्तवांश्च महाबाहुः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: For your sake used to career on the field of battle, like a boy of sixteen. The mighty-armed Dhananjaya, that son of Kunti, had said (before

sa: सर्वसैन्यानि राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽत्ययं गतः। दुर्योधनापराधेन क्षत्रं कृत्स्ना च मेदिनी॥
en: "These troops, the king Dhritarashtra himself, the Kshatriyas and the earth herself, are a'l now involved in a great calamity, through the fault of king Duryodhana.

sa: ततो हाहेति सहसा नादः समभवन्नृप। पाञ्चाल्येन रणे दृष्ट्वा द्रोणमावारितं शरैः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, suddenly cries of Alas and Oh were heard there, for, then Drona was seen covered with the shafts of the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: अकुर्वन् वचनं तस्य नूनं शोचति पुत्रकः॥ तदिदं समनुप्राप्तं वचनं दीर्घदर्शनः।
en: am Having disregarded the advice of that one of long foresight, my son is surely repenting that advice of his is now realised into its effect..

sa: हस्त्यङ्गान्यथ कर्णाय प्राहिणोत् पाण्डुनन्दनः। चक्राण्यश्वांस्तथा चान्यद् यत् यत् पश्यति भूतले॥८७
en: Then the son of Pandu began to throw at Barna, limbs of slain elephants and horses and car-wheels and everything he saw lying on the field.

sa: तेषु राजसहस्रेषु तावकेषु परेषु च। एक एव ज्वलंस्तस्थौ वृषसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Amongst the thousands of kings belonging to your party and that of your enemy, the puissant Vrishasena alone stood (on the field) like the blazing fire.

sa: ततस्तेऽपि नरव्याघ्राः पार्थं सर्वे महारथाः॥ अदृश्यं समरे चक्रुः सायकौघैः समन्ततः।
en: Thereupon those mighty car-warriors, those best of men, also rendered Pritha's son invisible in that battle, with the shower of their shafts poured from all sides.

sa: प्रहसंस्तु नरव्याघ्रः श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः॥ प्रत्यविध्यत् स तान् सर्वान् दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्।
en: Thereupon that foremost of men, that owner of white steed, who had Krishna for his charioteer pierced them all in return displaying great lightness of hand.

sa: तमेते प्रतिनन्दन्ति सिद्धाः सैन्याश्च विस्मितः। अजय्यं समरे दृष्ट्वा साधु साध्विति सात्यकिम्। योधाश्चोभयतः सर्वे कर्मभिः समपूजयन्॥
en: The Siddhas and the troops filled with delight, are praising him, saying 'excellent, excellent,' as they find that one of the Satvata race invincible. The warriors of both armies are applauding him, O monarch, in consequence of his fcats.

sa: हतं वैकर्तनं श्रुत्वा द्वैरथे सव्यसाचिना॥ जयतः पाण्डवान् दृष्ट्वा किंस्विदं दुर्योधनऽब्रवीत्।
en: Having seen that the son of Vikartana was slain by Savyasachin in a single combat and that the Pandavas were victorious, what, indeed, did Duryodhana say?

sa: आचार्यो यो धनुर्वेद गौतमो रथसत्तमः॥ कृपः शारद्वतस्तात हते कर्णे किमब्रवीत्।
en: What did that son of Sharadvata, Kripa of the Gautama race, that mighty, car-warrior, that teacher of archery, say when he saw Karna slain in battle?

sa: यत्रापश्यं हतं भीष्मं पश्यतस्तेऽनुजस्य वै। दुःशासनस्य कौरव्य कुर्वाणं कर्म दुष्करम्॥ अवध्यकल्पं संग्रामे देवैरपि सवासवैः। न ते वसुन्धरास्तीति तदाहं चिन्तये नृप॥
en: When, O Kaurava king, I behold that Bhishma, capable of achieving the most difficult exploits and unslayable even by the celestials together with Vasava in battle, was slain in your very sight and in that of your younger brother Dusasana, I thought, O king, that the earth no longer belonged to you.

sa: स्थाणुरुवाच वध्यास्ते सर्वतः पापाये युष्मास्वपराधिनः। मम तेजोबलार्धेन सर्वान् निघ्नत शात्रवान्॥
en: Sthanu said These sinful persons, who have insulted you, all should be slaughtered. Do you kill all these antagonists with one-half of my energy and prowess.

sa: रथी नागं समासाद्य दारयन् निशितैः शरैः। प्रेषयामास कालाय शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then the car-warrior, rushing against the elephant, pierced him with sharp arrows and led him towards the abode of Death by means of his straight shafts.

sa: आसंस्तु पाण्डुपुत्राणां त्रयो जिह्या महारथाः॥ यमौ च भीमसेनश्च प्राक्रोशंस्ते धनंजयम्।
en: Three of the mighty and war-like sons of Pandu were crooked-minded. They were the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) and Bhimasena. These then addressing Arjuna loudly said

sa: पश्य त्वं गर्जितस्यास्य फलं ते विप्र सानुगान्। हत्वा पाण्डुसुतानाजी सहकृष्णान् ससात्वतान्॥ दुर्योधनाय दास्यामि पृथिवीं हतकण्टकाम्।
en: O Brahmana, witness the result of these roars of mine. Having slain in battle the sons of Pandu together with Krishna. Sattvata and (all their) followers I will deliver the (entire) earth with its thorns weeded out, to Duryodhana.

sa: तदाऽऽसीत् तुमुलं युद्धं सर्वदोषविवर्जितम्। चतुर्णा तव योधानां तैसिभिः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: All then used straight and pure weapon and those three of the Pandava side, the battle, that occurred, was highly terrible, but free from all unfairness.

sa: ते अयं कालो महाबाहो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः॥ छिन्धि मूर्धानमस्याशु कुरु साफल्यमात्मनः।
en: O mighty-armed one this is the opportune moment to slay the wicked-souled weight. Now quickly lop off the head of this fellow and fulfill your vows.

sa: बाल्यात् प्रभृति चारिजः स्वानि दुःखानि चिन्तयन्। निरविद्यत धर्मात्मा जीवितेन वृकोदरः॥
en: Indeed the virtuous-souled Bhima that slayer of opponents recollecting all these hardships and those he had undergone since his childhood, became disregardful of his very life.

sa: एवं तस्य गुणान् प्रीतो बहुशोऽकथयत् प्रभुः। देवतानां पितॄणां च समक्षमरिसूदन॥
en: The lord, therefore, being thus satisfied with him, enumerated his several virtues in the presence of all the celestials and the Pitris, O slayer of enemies.

sa: तेषां नैष्फल्यमालोक्य पुनर्नव च पञ्च च। प्राहिणोनिशितान् बाणांस्ते चाभ्रश्यन्त वर्मणः॥
en: Beholding those shafts repelled, Partha once more struck Duryodhana with another nine and seven arrows of exceeding sharpness; but these also became baffled by Duryodhana's armour,

sa: अद्य त्वां समरे हित्वा नित्यं शूराभिमानिनम्। नन्दयिष्यामि दाशार्ह कुरुराजं सुयोधनम्॥
en: O scion of the Dasarha race, today slaying you who ever boast of your prowess, I shall afford delight to Suyodhana, the king of the Kurus.

sa: शैब्यो गोवासनो युद्धे काश्यपुत्रं महारथम्। ससैन्यो योधयामास गजः प्रतिगजं यथा॥
en: Shaivya the ruler of the Govasanas, with his troops, fought with that mighty car-warrior the son of Kasyapa, even as an elephant fights with its rival.

sa: नैनमाशंसिरे जेतुं दानवा वासवं यथा। केचिदासन् निरुत्साहाः केचित् क्रुद्धा मनस्विनः॥
en: None ventured to conquer him even as the Danavas could not conquer Vasava. Some were depressed at heart and some intelligent warriors became inspired with rage.

sa: संजय उवाच त्रिभागमात्रशेषायां रात्र्यां युद्धमवर्तत। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च संहृष्टानां विशाम्पते॥
en: Sanjaya said When three fourths of the night had passed away, O ruler of men, once more the battle, between the delighted Kurus and Pandavas, commenced.

sa: कौलूतका हयाचित्रा वहन्तस्तान् महारथान्। व्यशोभन्त तदा शीघ्रा दीपयन्तो दिशो दश॥
en: Steeds of best breed and variegated hue and endued with great fleetness, bearing those mighty car-warriors, appeared beautiful as they illumined the ten quarters of heaven.

sa: त्वमप्याशंसये योद्धं कुलजः क्षत्रियो ह्यसि। इमान् किं क्षत्रियान् सर्वान् घातयिष्यस्यनागसः॥
en: Why then do you cause the ruin of all these other un-offending Kshatriyas? You are the root of this hostility, so, do you yourself encounter Arjuna.

sa: तया हतः पतितो वेपमानो दुःशासनो गदया वेगवत्या। विध्वस्तवर्माभरणाम्बरस्त्रम् विचेष्टमानो भृशवेदनातुरः॥
en: When he reached and ground he was shaking all over from the shock of that weapon. All his ornaments, garlands and dresses were destroyed and torn.

sa: हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णमवप्लुत्य नरर्षभः॥ आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं कृपस्य शरपीडितः।
en: Afflicted with arrows of Kripa that foremost of men jumped down from the car of which the steeds were slain, quickly got up to another car.

sa: सा हेमचित्रा महती पाण्डवेन प्रवेरिता। निर्भिद्य दक्षिणं बाहुं प्राविशद् धरणीतलम्॥
en: Hurled by the son of Pandu that formidable (dart) ornamented with gold, penetrating through the right arm (of Kritavarma) entered into the bottom of the earth.

sa: व्यसृजत् सायकांस्तूर्णं रुक्मपुङ्खान् शिलाशितान्। ते शरा नतपर्वाणो विविशू राक्षसं तदा॥
en: Quickly created numerous arrows, furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone. Those shafts of depressed knots then penetrated into the body of the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha.

sa: द्रौणेस्तु धनुषः शब्दमहितत्रासनं रणे। अश्रौषं बहुशो राजन् सिंहस्य निनदो यता॥
en: Often and often did I hear in that battle, O king, the din of Drouni's volleys, thundering roars of lion to the consternation of the enemy.

sa: वामपार्वे तु तस्याथ भीमसेनो व्यवस्थितः। दक्षिणे च महेष्वासो धृष्टद्युम्नो व्यवस्थितः॥ मध्ये व्यूहस्य राजा तु पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च धर्मराजस्य पृष्ठतः॥
en: Thereupon Bhimasena was stationed in the left side of that (half-moon); and the mighty bowman, Dhristadyumna, was placed in the right. In the middle (of that half-moon arrangement) both the monarch and the Pandava Dhananjaya were stationed. But Nakula and Shahadeva were placed in the rear of the king of righteousness (Yudhishthira.)

sa: इत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवो राजन् युयुधानवृकोदरौ। सखजे पुरुषव्याघ्रौ हर्षाद् वाष्पं मुमोच ह॥
en: Having said these words, these words, o king! Yudhishithira, the son of Pandu embraced Satyaki and Bhimasena both and his eyes started shedding tears of joy.

sa: अहं पार्थान् हनिष्यामि सपञ्चालान् ससोमकान्॥ अद्य मे युध्यमानस्य सह गाण्डीवधन्वना।
en: I will myself destroy Partha together with the Panchalas assembled (under his banners). In the battle that I will today fight with the wielder of Gandiva.

sa: उत्सारयन्तः प्रभया तमस्ते चन्द्ररश्मयः। पर्यगच्छञ्छनैः सर्वा दिशः खंच क्षिति तथा॥
en: Then the rays of that lustrous orb, dispelling the gloom of night gradually spread themselves on the earth, the welkin and the directions of the compass.

sa: समरश्लाघिनौ वीरौ समरेष्वपराजितौ। मम वाक्य समौ चैव दिष्ट्या पश्यामि वामहम्॥
en: You both warriors keep my words while competing with rivals and undefeated in the battle field. It is my high destiny to see you safe here.

sa: युध्यस्व यत्नमास्थाय दैवं कृत्वा यततस्तव तेषां च दैवं मार्गेण यास्यति॥
en: Hurling defiance at fate, fight with (utmost) care. Between yourself and themselves, fate will espouse the cause of the party that will make the best exertion.

sa: सम्भग्नं हि बलं दृष्ट्वा बलात् पार्थेन तावकम्। धनुर्विस्फारयन् कर्णस्तस्थौ शत्रुजिघांसया॥
en: And Karna, beholding that all the troops have been broken by the prowess of Partha, stretched out his bow for the purposed of killing his enemy.

sa: नाहत्वा विनिवर्तिष्ये कर्णमद्य रणाजिरात्। इति सत्येन ते पादौ स्पृशामि जगतीपते॥
en: O lord of the universe, I swear unto you by your feet that I shall not return from the terrible battle today without having slain Karna.

sa: तच्छिन्नं सहसा तस्य शिरः कुञ्चितमूर्धजम्। सकिरीटं महीं प्राप्य बभौ ज्योतिरिवाम्बरात्॥
en: That head graced with curling locks and a beautiful diadem, suddenly cut-off, fell on the earth and shone like a meteor dropped down from the heavens.

sa: व्यपसृत्य तु नागाभ्यां मण्डलानि विचेरतुः। प्रगृह्य चोभौ धनुषी जनतुर्वै परस्परम्॥
en: Having receded back, they (the two heroes) roved about in circles dismounting from their elephants, and also having taken up their bows, really struck each other.

sa: अतः प्रहर्षः सुमहान् युयुधानाद्य मेऽभवत्। मृतं प्रत्यागतमिव दृष्ट्वा पार्थं धनंजयम्॥
en: Therefore, O Yuyudhana, a great joy has taken possession of myself today, in as much as I look upon Pritha's son as returned from the dead.

sa: तत् सागरमिवोधुतं रजसा संवृत्तं बलम्॥ विदार्य पाण्डवैः क्रुद्धस्त्वया गुप्तैर्हतं बिभो।
en: O puissant one, the hostile troops shrouded with dust looked like a surging sea and the infuriated Pandavas, forcing their way amongst them, threw them over-board.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा द्रवतः शूरान् पञ्चालान् सहसोमकान्॥२३ धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज द्रौणिमभ्यद्रवद् रणे।
en: Witnessing the flight of those heroes that is, the Panchalas and the Somakas, Dhristadyumna, O great king, rushed against the son of Drona in that battle.

sa: श्रुतं भवद्भिर्यत् प्रोक्तं भगवद्भ्यां जगद्धितम्। तत्तथा नान्यथा तद्धि तिष्ठध्वं विगतज्वराः॥
en: You hear what the two Gods say for the good of the whole world and it must surely be so and no otherwise; so rest assured.

sa: शस्त्राण्येषां राजेन्द्र शोणिताक्तानि सर्वशः। प्राभ्रश्यन्त करोग्रेभ्यो दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं हतं युधि॥
en: Beholding the death of Drona in battle, O foremost of kings, the weapons of many of them, indeed besmeared with blood, dropped down from their hands.

sa: त्वद्धितार्थं तु स मया हतः संग्राममूर्धनि। चेदिराजश्च विक्रान्तः प्रत्यक्षं निहतस्तव॥
en: For your good, he was slain by me in the van of battle. The powerful ruler of the Chedis was also slain before your very eyes.

sa: तपान्ते जलदो यद्वच्छरधाराः क्षरन् मुहुः। दिव्यास्रजलदः कर्णः पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्॥
en: Just like clouds at the end of summer pouring torrents of rain, Karna, shooting incessantly showers of arrows, resembles a pouring cloud charged with celestial weapons.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्चनम्। बाह्रीकस्य रणे राजन् सात्यकिः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Then again, Oking, Satyaki, as if with a smile in that battle, cut down with another broad-headed shafts the golden standard of the son of Balhika.

sa: ततस्तं निशित खड्गमाविध्य युधि सत्वरः। धनुश्चान्यत् समादाय शरं जग्राह वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then having turned round that sharp-edged sword in the field of battle, the most powerful one took up another bow most rapidly and grasped an arrow.

sa: ऊर्ध्वमुत्पत्य हैडिम्बिस्तां मायां माययावधीत्॥ सोऽभिवीक्ष्य हतां मायां मायावी माययैव हि।
en: Soaring high, destroyed it by his own illusive power. Possessed of potent illusive powers Alayudha then seeing his own illusions nullified by those of his adversary.

sa: अभ्यगाद्धरणी घोरः श्वसन्निव महोरगः। निर्भिन्ने तु भुजे सव्ये सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Entered the earth, like a mighty and dreadful snake breathing fiercely. When his left arm had been thus pierced Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled.

sa: ते शरा हेमविकृताः सम्पतन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः। श्रेणीकृता व्यकाशन्त क्रौञ्चाः श्रेणीकृता इव॥
en: Those arrows, that were adorned with gold, having issued forth in continuous lines, looked most handsome like the cranes flying in continuous lines (through the sky).

sa: एतेषां युयुधानेन युध्यतां युधि भारत। बभूव तुमुलः शब्दः प्रेतानां क्रन्दतामिव॥
en: Thus when they were being thus slaughtered by Yuyudhana in battle, O Bharata, a tumultuous uproar was heard there like the yell or bewailing of ghosts.

sa: सात्यकिरुवाच न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्यो इति यन्मां प्रभाषत। धर्मवादैरधर्मिष्ठा धर्मकञ्चकमास्थिताः॥
en: Satyaki said You, sinful Kauravas, vested in outward garments of virtue, you are telling me in words of virtue, that Bhurisravas should not have been slain.

sa: तमसा संवृते चैव समन्ताद् विप्रदुद्रुवुः। ते सर्वतो विद्रवन्तो योधा विध्वस्तचेतनाः॥
en: And surrounded by that dense gloom, took to flight in all directions. And with their minds (greatly) agitated (with terror) they ran away on all sides.

sa: स रथं प्राप्य तं भ्रातुर्दुर्योधनहयाशरैः। बहुभिस्ताडयामास ते हताः प्रापतन् भुवि॥
en: Ascending the car of his brother, he wounded the horses of Duryodhana with numerous arrows and the horse then slain fell down dead on the ground.

sa: त्वं तु गच्छ मयाऽऽज्ञप्तो जहि युद्धे घटोत्कचम्। राक्षसं क्रूरकर्माणं रक्षोमानुषसम्भवम्॥
en: “Supported by Drona and Karna and others, I am competent enough to conquer my enemies. With my leave, do you go and slay the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha.

sa: उरसा धारयन्निष्कं कण्ठसूत्रं च भास्वरम्। चापं च रुक्मविकृतं विधुन्वन् गजमूर्धनि॥
en: And bearing on his breast a Niska hanging by a lustrous chain round the neck and stretching his golden bow sitting on the back the elephants.

sa: अद्भुतं चाप्यचिन्त्यं च दृष्ट्वा कर्म तयो रणे। सिद्धरचारणसंघाना विस्मयः समपद्यत॥
en: Having witnessed the extraordinary and inconceivable achievements of those two in the field of battle, the assemblage of the Siddhas and the Charanas were greatly astonished.

sa: ततः स शुशुभे राजन् कण्ठासक्तमहाधनुः॥ परिवेषमनुप्राप्तो यथा स्याद् व्योम्नि चन्द्रमाः। यथैव चासितो मेघः शक्रचापेन शोभितः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, that strong bow placed round his neck, blazed forth, like the moon in the firmament, when he is surrounded by a halo of light or like the mass of black clouds adorned by the bow Indra.

sa: तथा विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ सहसुतौ नृपौ। पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे द्रोणेन निहतौ रणे॥
en: So also, the old king Virata and Drupada, displaying their prowess in battle, were slain by Drona for sake of their ally, with all their sons.

sa: हयान् रथांश्च समरे शस्त्रैः शतसहस्रशः॥ वध्यमाने ततः सैन्ये भयं सुमहदाविशत्। संशप्तकगणानां च गोपालानां च भारत॥
en: Thousands of horses and cars were also destroyed by those weapons. The army being thus slaughtered they were possessed by terrible fear. O descendant of Bharata, there was no man amongst the Samsaptakas and Gopalas who could withstand Arjuna.

sa: यदि युद्धेन जेयाः स्युरिमे कौरवनन्दनाः। वयमप्यव युध्येम तथा चेमे नरर्षभाः॥
en: Had it been possible now to vanquish the Kouravas in battle, then we as well as all these forest of men would have fought against them.

sa: स हि भीमो रथश्चास्य हयाः सूतश्च मारिष। संवृता द्रोणपुत्रेण पावकान्तर्गताऽभवन्॥
en: Then thus shrouded with shafts by Drona's son, Bhima, his horses and charioteer, O sire, looked as if wrapt in the flames of a blazing fire.

sa: स रवस्तस्य शूरस्य धर्मराजस्य भारत। आचख्याविव तद् युद्धं विजयं चात्मनो महत्॥ तं श्रुत्वा तु महानादं भीमसेनस्य धन्विनः। बभूव परमा प्रीतिधर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥ ततो दृष्टमना राजन् वादित्राणां महाखनैः। सिंहनादरवं भ्रातुः प्रतिजग्राह पाण्डवः॥ हर्षेण महता युक्तः कृतसंज्ञो वृकोदरे। अभ्ययात् समरे द्रोणं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: The very virtuous king Yudhishthira obtained great delight in battle. Then highly delighted, that son of Pandu, O mighty monarch, received the sound of the war-cry of his brother with the beating of drums and other musical instruments. After Vrikodara had given him that intelligence by the hint agreed upon by both, that foremost of persons Yudhishthira versed in the use of all weapons, joyfully rushed against Drona in that battle. On the other hand, O monarch, seeing thirty-one of your son's slain in battle, Duryodhana recalled to mind the words of Vidura thus, "those salutary words spoken by Vidura are now being realised.

sa: आत्मापराधे सुमहन्नूनं तप्यति पुत्रकः। को हि जीवितमन्विच्छन् प्रतीपं पाण्डवं व्रजेत्॥
en: In consequence of his own fault surely my son is being greatly afflicted. What person willing to live still, with hostile intentions, advance against Pandu's son.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all the male beings (Nara) and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry success!

sa: संजय उवाच केशवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा बीभत्सुरपि राक्षसम्। अभ्यभाषत कौरव्य घटोत्कचमरिंदमम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing the words of Kesava, Vibhatsu also addressing that Rakshasa, that slayer of foes viz., Ghatotkacha said, O foremost of the Kurus, these words.

sa: सोऽपेतवर्मा पुत्रस्ते विरराज भृशं नृप। उत्सृज्य काले राजेन्द्र निर्मोकमिव पन्नगः॥
en: His armour being cut-off, your son O monarch, O lord of kings, looked as beautiful as a snake with its slough cast off in proper time.

sa: व्यादिदेश तथा सैन्यं तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे॥ ततः प्रववृते युद्धं रात्रौ भरतसत्तम।
en: Then cominanded his army (to act in obedience to his orders) during that dreadfully dark night. Then, O most exalted of Bharatas, took place a battle.

sa: द्रवमाणं तु तत् सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा विगतचेतनम्। मध्यस्थतां च पार्थस्य धर्मपुत्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Then behoiding the army broken and deprived of its senses and seeing the indifference of Partha, the very virtuous king Yudhishthira thus spokeधृष्टद्युम्न पलायस्व सह पाञ्चालसेनया।

sa: संरब्धा हि स्थिरीभूता द्रोणपुत्रेण कौरवाः। उदग्राः पाण्डुपञ्चाला द्रोणस्य निधनेन च॥
en: The Kouravas were rallied and incited with revenge by Drona's son, the Pandavas and Panchalas were also excited to fury by having slain the Preceptor Drona.

sa: सौहार्दै सर्वभूतेषु यः करोत्यतिमानुषः। सोऽद्य केशग्रहं श्रुत्वा पितुर्धक्ष्यति नो रणे॥
en: He, who ever treated all creatures with exceeding compassion, even he, hearing that his sire was dragged by the hair will today consume us in battle.

sa: तं निर्जित्य रणे राजन्नुलूकस्त्वरितो ययौ। पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयांश्चैव विनिघ्नन् निशितैः शरैः॥
en: O monarch, Uluka, after having defeated him (his antagonist) in the battle, hastened towards the Panchalas and the Srinjayas and slew them with the keen arrows.

sa: तत् प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा कौन्तेयेनामितौजसा॥ राधेयो वाप्याधिरथिः कर्णः किमकरोद् युधि। पुत्रा वा मम दुर्धर्षा राजानो वा महारथाः। एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: How did Karna, the son of Adhiratha and Radha, behave in that battle, on finding our troops worsted and beaten by Kunti's son of illimitable prowess? And also what did my unconquerable sons and the other kings and mighty charioteers of our army do? Tell me of all these, O Sanjaya, because you are a skilled narrator.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच ततोऽस्त्राणि समस्तानि वरांश्च मनसेप्सितान्॥ लख्वा बहुविधान् रामः प्रणम्य शिरसा भवम्। अनुज्ञां प्राप्य देवेशाजगाम स महातपाः॥
en: Duryodhana said Thereupon, having obtained all the diverse kinds of weapons and boons desired in his heart, Rama performed the ceremony of bowing down his head to Shiva. Thus having received the command from the lord of the celestials, that great devotee went away.

sa: ब्राह्यं पञ्चालाः कौरवेयास्तु धर्म्य सत्यं मत्स्याः शूरसेनाश्च यज्ञम्। प्राच्या दासा वृषला दाक्षिणात्याः स्तेना वाहीका: संकरा वै सुराष्ट्राः॥
en: The Panchalas observe the duties laid down in the Vedas; the Kauravas observe truth; the Matsyas Surasena perform Yajnas; the people of the east follow the conduct of the Sudras. Those of the south are fallen; the Bahikas are thieves, the Saurashtras are bastards.

sa: इति वाक्यान्तरे तस्य करालः कृष्णपिङ्गलः। वामनो विकटो मुण्डी नन्दी हस्वभुजो बली॥ ततः पार्श्वमुपागभ्य भवस्यानुचरोऽब्रवीत्। नन्दीश्वरो वचश्चेदं राक्षसेन्द्रमशङ्कितः॥
en: As they were speaking thus, that attendant of Bhava, Nandi, terrific, of yellow black hue, dwarfish, frightful, with his head shaven, having short arms, and stout, coming up to them, said (this). And the lordly Nandi, undaunted, addressed the sovereign of the Raksasas, saying.

sa: अनिशं यत्र पुरुषा गणका लेखकास्तदा। युधिष्ठिरस्य वचनादपृच्छन्त स्म तं नृपम्॥ आज्ञापय किमेतेभ्यः प्रदायं दीयतामिति। तदुपस्थितमेवात्र वचनान्ते ददुस्तदा॥
en: Teller sand scribes on that occasion, under the orders of Yudhishthira, ceaselessiy asked the old king, Do you command, O king, what gifts should be made to these, All things are ready here-As soon as the king spoke, they gave away what he directed.

sa: यथा ह्यनुदये राजन् भूतानि शशिसूर्ययोः। अन्धे तमसि मज्जेयुरपश्यन्तः परस्परम्॥ यथा ह्यनुदके मत्स्या निराक्रन्दे विहङ्गमाः। विहरेयुर्यथाकामं विहिंसन्तः पुनः पुनः॥ विमथ्यातिक्रमेरंश्च विषह्यापि परस्परम्। अभावमचिरेणैव गच्छेयुर्नात्र संशयः॥ एवमेव विना राज्ञा विनश्येयुरिमाः प्रजाः। अन्धे तमसि मज्जेयुरगोपाः पशवो यथा॥
en: As, o king, all creatures cannot see one another and sink in utter darkness if the sun and the moon do not rise, as fishes in shallow water and birds in a safe place dart and move about as they please (for a time) and repeatedly attack and grind one another with force and then are destroyed so men sink in utter darkness and meet with destruction if they have no king to protect them like a herd of cattle without the herdsman to take care of them.

sa: अमाद्यदिन्द्रः सोमेन दक्षिणाभिर्द्विजातयः। व्युषिताश्वस्य राजर्षेस्ततो यज्ञे महात्मनः॥ देवा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव चक्रुः कर्म स्वयं तदा। व्युषिताश्वस्ततो राजन्नति मान् व्यरोचत॥
en: In the sacrifice of the illustrious royal sage Vyushitashva, Indra was so intoxicated with Soma drink and the Brahmanas with Dakshina (offerings) that the celestial and the Brahmana Rishis performed everything of it themselves. O king, thereupon Vyushitashva began to shine over all creatures.

sa: अमोघाः सूर्यसंकाशा ममेमे निचिताः शराः॥ तस्मिन् वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते निपतिष्यन्ति वेगिताः। कङ्कपत्रप्रतिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसंनिभाः॥ तीक्ष्णाग्रा ऋजुपर्वाणः सरोषा भुजगा इव।
en: These infallible sharpened shafts of inine, resembling the sun, feathered with the plumes of the Kanka, like to the thunderbolt of the great Indra, having sharp heads and even knots, like in infuriated serpents,-being let go with vehermence, shall alight upon the impious Vali.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कश्चिद् ऋषिौम्यो नामायोदः। तस्य शिष्यास्त्रयो बभूवुः॥ उपमन्युरारुणिर्वेदश्चेति स एकं शिष्यमारुणिं पाञ्चाल्यं प्रेषयामास 'गच्छ, केदारखण्डं बधान' इति॥
en: About this time there was also a Rishi, named Ayoda-Dhaumya. He had three disciples namely Upamanyu, Aruni and Veda. One day the Rishi asked one of these three disciples, Aruni of Panchala, to go and stop a breach in the water-course in his field.

sa: अकृत्वा देवपूजां च नाचरेद् दन्तधावनम्। अकृत्वा देवपूजां च नाभिगच्छेत् कदाचन। अन्यत्र तु गुरुं वृद्धं धार्मिकं वा विचक्षणम्॥ अवलोक्यो न चादर्शो मलिनो बुद्धिमत्तरैः।
en: One should not adore the celestials without having first washed his teeth. Without also adoring the celestials first, one should never repair to any person except his preceptor or one who is old in years or one who is righteous or one who is wise. Wise men should never see themselves in an unnolished or dirty mirror.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते वीरे नकुले चारुदर्शने। पुनरेव तदा भीमो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥ योऽयमक्षतधर्मात्मा भ्राता वचनकारकः। रूपेणाप्रतिमो लोके नकुलः पतितो भुवि॥
en: Upon the falling down of the heroic Nakula of great beauty, Bhima once more addressed the king, saying, 'This brother of ours who was gifted with full righteousness and who always obeyed our commands, this Nakula who was peerless for beauty, has fallen down!'

sa: स एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच जनमेजयम् 'भो जनमेजय, पुत्रोऽयं मम सर्म्या जातो महातपस्वी स्वाध्यायसंपन्नो मत्तपोवीर्यसंभृतो मच्छुक्रं पीतवत्यास्तस्याः कुक्षौ जातः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Janamejaya, the Rishi replied, “O Janamejaya, my son is accomplished in the study of the Vedas, endued with my full asceticism and deep in devotion, but he is born in the womb of a serpent who swallowed my vital fluid.

sa: दक्षिणं दक्षिणं काले सम्भृत्य स्वभुजं तदा। हस्तिहस्तोपमं शैक्षं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम्॥ प्रगृह्णन्नञ्जलीन् नृणामुद्यतान् सर्वतो दिशः। शुश्राव मधुरा वाचो नानादेशनिवासिनाम्॥
en: Followed and surrounded by his uterine brother, he proceeded, raising his right arm sinewy like the trunk of the elephant and capable of crushing all his foes, and therewith accepting the homage's offered by men on all sides with their raised and folder palms.

sa: नहि प्रतिज्ञां कुर्वन्ति वितथा सत्यवादिनः। लक्षणं हि महत्त्वस्य प्रतिज्ञापरिपालनम्॥ नैराश्यमुपगन्तुं च नालं ते मत्कृतेऽनघ। वधेन रावणस्याद्य प्रतिज्ञामनुपालय॥
en: Those speaking the truth, never falsify their promise: the mark of a great one is even observance of vow. O sinless one, do not suffer yourself to be overcome by despair on my account. Do you today by slaying Rāvaņa, make your promise good.

sa: दक्षिणा रूपवत्यश्च स्त्रियः पानवशं गताः॥ उपानृत्यन्त काकुत्स्थं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः। मनोभिरामा रामास्ता रामो रमयतां वरः॥ रमयामास धर्मात्मा नित्यं परमभूषिताः।
en: The intelligent and beautiful females being intoxicated after taking wine, and well-skilled in the art of singing and dancing, began to dance before Råma. The virtuous-souled Rāma, the foremost of those who know how to please, satisfied those beautiful damsels adorned with various ornaments.

sa: दशग्रीवस्तु वैदेहीं रक्षितां राक्षसीगणैः। ददर्श दीनां दुःखार्ती नावं सन्नामिवार्णवे॥ असंवृतायामासीनां धरण्यां संशितव्रताम्। छिन्नां प्रपतितां भूमौ शाखामिव वनस्पतेः॥
en: Arriving there the Ten-necked one beheld Vaidehi, guarded by the Raksasis, poorly, racked with grief like to a boat sunk in an ocean. Subject to hard penances, she, seated on the bare earth, appeared like a branch of a tree fallen on the ground

sa: विवृत्तनयनं क्रोधात्सफेनं रुधिराप्लुतम्। ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षं विरूपाक्षतरं कृतम्॥ स्फुरन्तं परिवर्तन्तं पार्श्वेन रुधिरोक्षितम्। करुणं च विनर्दन्तं ददृशुः कपयो रिपुम्॥
en: Blood gushed out of the person of Virūpākșa like to water issuing out of a fountain. And the monkeys beheld their enemy (Virūpākṣa) with his eyes disfigured in anger, bathed in a foam of blood, his whole body discoloured, trembling, rolling and crying piteously.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम सुमाली नाम राक्षसः। नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धस्तत्सैन्यं सोऽभ्यवर्तत॥ स दैवतबलं सर्वं नानाप्रहरणैः शितैः। व्यध्वंसयत संक्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरं यथा॥
en: In the interim, O Rāma, a Rākşasa, Sumāli, by name, getting enraged, and with diverse weapons, ran amok of the soldiery. As the winds scatter clouds, so he, under the influence of rage, with various sharpened weapons, committed a havoc among the celestial soldiers.

sa: शक्तीनां विमलाचाणां तोमराणां तथाऽस्यताम्। निस्त्रिंशानां च पीतानां नीलोत्पलनिभाः प्रभाः॥ कवचानां विचित्राणां भूषणानां प्रभास्तथा। खं दिशः प्रदिशश्चैव भासयामासुरोजसा॥
en: The effulgence, like that of blue lotuses, of Shaktis with shinning heads, of hurled lances, of well-tempered swords. As also effulgence of the coats of mail and of diverse and wonderful ornaments, filled the firmament and the cardinal and subsidiary quarters with its flashes.

sa: सहस्रशश्च सौवर्णान् वृषभान् गोशतानुगान्। साष्टं शतं सुवर्णानां निष्कमाहुर्धनं तथा॥ अध्यर्धमासमददद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यः शतं समाः। अग्निहोत्रोपकरणं यज्ञोपकरणं च यत्॥
en: For a hundred years, twice a month, he gave away unto thousands of Brahmanas a golden bull each followed by a herd of hundred cows and eight hundred pieces of Nishkas. All the articles necessary for his Agnihotra sacrifice and for his other sacrifices.

sa: हतसारथिरप्युच्चैः पपात काष्ठवद् रथः। युध्यमानस्य संग्रामे व्यूढे रजसि चोत्थिते॥ धनुः कूजितविज्ञानं तत्रासीत् प्रतियुद्ध्यतः। गात्रस्पर्शेन योधानां व्यज्ञास्त परिपन्थिनम्॥
en: Many great car-warriors were seen to fall down from high, their charioteers being killed. A thick dust covered all sides. Then the warriors knew their adversaries by the twang of the bow. From the pressure also on their bodies the combatants guessed their enemies.

sa: प्रगृह्य विपुलं चापं सिंहवद् विनदन् मुहुः। पृष्ठतोऽनुययौ चैनं स्रवद्भिः पर्वतोपमैः॥ कुञ्जरैर्दशसाहस्रैर्वङ्गानामधिपः स्वयम्। तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य गजानीकेन संवृतम्॥ पुत्रं तव महाराज चुकोप स निशाचरः। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Grasping a bow with arrows fixed on the string and uttering his war cries incessantly and loud. Behind him followed the ruler of the Bangas himself, supported by ten thousand elephants prodigious like the hills and with the temporal juice flowing down. Beholding your son surrounded by the elephant division rush to battle, O mighty monarch, that night-ranger became inflamed with wrath; then regard a combat, dreadful and hair stirring.

sa: यथेन्द्रस्य महाराज महत्या दैत्यसेनया। तस्य सैन्यस्य संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य भारत॥ बभूव सुमहान् शब्दः सागरस्येव गर्जतः। अन्योन्यं स्म तदा योधा विकर्षन्तो विशाम्पते॥ महीं चक्रुश्चितां सर्वां शशलोहितसंनिभाम्। योधांश्च स्वान् परान् वापि नाभ्यजानञ्जिघांसया॥
en: O great king, it resembled the battle that was fought between Indra and the great host of the Danavas. O descendant of Bharata, loud uproar rose from that mighty army fighting in that battle. It resembled the sound of the roaring ocean. O king, they cut down one another and made the whole field resemble a crematorium strewn with flesh and blood. Impelled by the desire to kill, they could not distinguish friends from foes.

sa: अथ ते द्रौपदीपुत्राः सौभद्रश्च महारथः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ धार्तराष्ट्रान् प्रतिययुरर्दयन्तः शितैः शरैः। वज़ैरिव महावेगैः शिखराणि धराभृताम्॥
en: The sons of Draupadi, the great car-warrior (Abhimanyu) son of Subhadra, Nakula and Sahadeva, Dhrishtadyumna, the of Prishata, all rushed against the warriors of Dhritarashtra's son and tore them asunder with sharp arrows as the summits of mountains are broken down by the thunder-bolt.

sa: तमायान्तं महेष्वासं सोदर्याः पर्यवारयन्। छादयन्तः शरवातैर्मेघा इव दिवाकरम्॥ दुर्योधनश्च पुत्रस्ते दुर्मुखो दुःशलः शलः। दुःशासनश्चातिरथस्तथा दुर्मर्षणो नृप॥ विविंशतिश्चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च महारथः। पुरुमित्रो जयो भोजः सौमदत्तिश्च वीर्यवान्।॥ महाचापानि धुन्वन्तो मेघा इव सविद्युतः। आददानाश्च नाराचान् निर्मुक्ताशीविषोपमान्॥
en: Then all the brothers, your Duryodhana, Durmukha, Dushala, that great car-warrior Dushasana, Durmarshana, Vivingshati, Chitrasena, the great car-warrior Vikarna and also Purumitra, Jaya, Bhoja, the brave son of Somadatta, all these heroes, shaking their bows which looked like so many masses of clouds charged with flashes of lightning, and taking out long arrows loO king like so many snakes that have cast off their sloughs, surrounded that great bowman (Bhima) and covered him with a shower of arrows, as clouds cover the sun.

sa: दशभिर्दशभिर्भीष्ममर्दयामासुरोजसा। शिखण्डी तु महाबाणान् यान् मुमोच महारथः॥ न चक्रुस्ते रुजं तस्य स्वर्णपङ्खाः शिलाशिताः। ततः किरीटी संरब्धो भीष्ममेवाभ्यधावत॥
en: Pierced him with force, each shooting ten arrows. Those dreadful arrows which that mighty car-warrior Shikhandin shot, and which were furnished with wings of gold and whetted on stone, quickly penetrated the body of Bhishma. Thereupon the diadem-decked Arjuna waxing worth rushed at Bhishma,

sa: किमिदं नष्टरूपाः स्थ कचित् क्षेमं दिवौकसाम्। तामूचुर्वसवो देवाः शप्ताः स्मो वै महानदि॥ अल्पेऽपराधे संरम्भाद् वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। विमूढा हि वयं सर्वे प्रच्छन्नमृषिसत्तमम्॥ संध्यां वप्तिष्ठमासीनं तमत्यभिसृताः पुरा। तेन कोपाद् वयं शप्ता योनौ सम्भवतेति ह॥
en: The best of rivers, seeing them in that state them, "O dwellers of heaven, why do you look dejected? Is every thing all right with you?" The celestial Vasus replied to her, “O great river, we have been cursed for our little fault by the illustrious Vasistha in anger. Vasishtha was engaged in his Sandhya (twilight worship); that best of Rishis was not seen by us. We in our ignorance crossed him. Therefore, he cursed us in anger, saying, 'Be born as men.'

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सुरापानाद् वञ्चनां प्राप्य विद्वान् संज्ञानाशं चैव महातिघोरम्। दृष्ट्वा कचं चापि तथाभिरूपं पीतं तदा सुरया मोहितेन॥ स्तदोशना विप्रहितं चिकीर्षुः। सुरापानं प्रति संजातमन्युः काव्यः स्वयं वाक्यमिदं जगाद।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been deceived while under the influence of wine and remembering the terrible consequences of drink and the total loss of consciousness, the result of it and seeing before him the handsome Kacha whom he had drink with the wine while intoxicated, (the learned Shukra), with the wish of effecting a reform in the manner of the Brahmanas, rose from the ground in anger and spoke thus-

sa: जनमेजय उवाच बालोऽप्ययं स्थविर इवावभाषते नायं बालः स्थविरोऽयं मतो मे। इच्छाम्यहं वरमस्मै प्रदातुं तन्मे विप्राः संविदध्वं यथावत्॥
en: Janamejaya said : Though this (Rishi) is but a boy, he speaks like a wise old man. He is not a boy; I think he is wise and old. I wish to bestow on him a boon. Therefore, O Brahmanas, give me necessary permission.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गङ्गाद्वारं प्रति महान् बभूव भगवानृपिः। भरद्वाज इति ख्यातः सततं संशितव्रतः॥ सोऽभिषेक्तुं ततो गङ्गां पूर्वमेवागमनन्नदीम्। महर्षिभिर्भरद्वाजो हविर्धाने चरन् पुरा॥ ददर्शाप्सरसं साक्षाद् घृताचीमाप्लुतामृषिः। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नां मददृप्तां मदालसाम्॥ तस्याः पुनर्नदीतीरे वसनं पर्यवर्तत। व्यपकृष्टाम्बरां दृष्ट्वा तामृषिश्चक्रमे ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : There lived at the source of the Ganges a great and high-souled Rishi who was known as Bharadvaja and he was always observing rigid vows. In the time of yore, Rishi Bharadvaja one day, intending to perform Agnihotra, went many other great Rishis to the Ganges to perform ablution. The Rishi was Ghritachi herself, the Apsara, young and beautiful, proud and voluptuous, rising from the water. As she rose, her cloth became loose and disordered. Seeing her cloth disordered, the Rishi became full of desire.
